title: Hr intern
description:
Job Description – Human Resources (HR) Intern

**Organization:** Tinplate CTC  
**Position:** Human Resources (HR) Intern  
**Internship Type:** Internship  
**Mode:** Work From Home / work from office

**Duration:** 1 to 6 Months

About the Internship

Tinplate CTC is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Human Resources Intern** to support various HR functions and gain practical exposure to recruitment, employee coordination, documentation, and day\-to\-day HR operations. This internship provides an opportunity to develop hands\-on HR skills while working closely with the team in a professional environment.

Roles and Responsibilities

As an HR Intern, you will be responsible for:

* Assisting in the end\-to\-end recruitment and selection process.
* Sourcing and screening candidates through various recruitment platforms.
* Coordinating and scheduling interviews with candidates and interview panels.
* Communicating with candidates regarding interview schedules, selection updates, and onboarding processes.
* Maintaining and regularly updating candidate and employee databases.
* Supporting the preparation of Job Descriptions (JDs) for different roles.
* Assisting with onboarding and orientation activities for new interns or team members.
* Maintaining attendance, performance, and other HR\-related records.
* Supporting employee engagement and internal communication activities.
* Coordinating with team members to ensure smooth execution of HR processes.
* Assisting in preparing HR reports, trackers, and documentation.
* Performing other HR and administrative responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager.

Skills Required

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic understanding of Human Resource Management and recruitment.
* Strong interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and Google Workspace.
* Attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Who Can Apply?

Candidates who:

* Are currently pursuing or have completed a degree in HR, Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Have an interest in building a career in Human Resources.
* Are available for the required internship duration.
* Can effectively manage responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* Are proactive, responsible, and eager to gain practical industry experience.

Learning Opportunities

During the internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

* Recruitment and talent acquisition
* Candidate screening and interview coordination
* HR operations and documentation
* Employee engagement
* Performance and attendance tracking
* Professional communication and stakeholder management
* HR reporting and database management

What You Will Gain

* Hands\-on experience in core HR functions.
* Practical understanding of recruitment and HR operations.
* Exposure to real\-world workplace processes.
* Opportunity to develop communication, coordination, and management skills.
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion, subject to organizational policies.

Pay: ₹2,500\.00 \- ₹24,291\.60 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

**Job Title: Lead Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations \& HR Functional Consultant**

**Experience**

**Total Exp : 10\+yrs**

**7–12 years** of ERP / CRM experience with strong **end‑to‑end Dynamics 365 Project Operations and HR/HCM implementation** exposure, including solution leadership, integration design, and stakeholder management.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a **Lead D365 Project Operations \& HR Functional Consultant** who can design, configure, and implement solutions across the **project lifecycle and employee lifecycle**. The role involves bridging business requirements with D365 system functionality, driving **fit‑gap analysis**, enabling **project financials and resource management**, and ensuring seamless **integration with Finance \& Operations (F\&O)**. The consultant will work closely with **PMOs, HR leaders, finance stakeholders, and delivery teams** to deliver scalable, governed solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Requirements, Fit‑Gap \& Solution Design**

* Lead **business workshops** with PMO, project managers, finance controllers, and HR stakeholders.
* Gather and translate business requirements into **D365 Project Operations and HR solution designs**.
* Perform **FIT/GAP analysis** and recommend configurations, integrations, or extensions aligned with platform best practices.
* Prepare and own **Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs)**, process flows, and solution blueprints.

**2\) Project Operations Functional Ownership**

* Configure and implement **end‑to‑end Project Operations**, including:
* Project lifecycle setup
* **Work Breakdown Structures (WBS)**
* Project budgeting and forecasting
* Project quoting and contract management
* Resource scheduling and assignment
* **Time and expense management**
* Strong understanding of **project accounting concepts**, including:
* Costing, billing, revenue recognition
* Actuals vs forecasts
* Project profitability and financial controls
* Ability to design project models for **professional services / project‑based delivery organizations**.

**3\) HR / HCM Functional Exposure**

* Configure and deploy **Dynamics 365 HR (Human Resources)** capabilities, including:
* Organizational structures
* Employee lifecycle management
* Position, job, and worker data
* Exposure to HR processes such as:
* Onboarding and employee administration
* Benefits, time off, or talent processes (as applicable)
* Ensure alignment between **HR, Project Operations, and Finance** for resource and cost management.

**4\) Finance Integration \& Platform Connectivity**

* Strong experience configuring and validating **Project Operations integration with F\&O**, including:
* **Dual‑write** for project, resource, and financial data synchronization
* Alignment of project financials with GL and sub‑ledgers
* Functional understanding of how Project Ops interacts with **Finance modules** for billing, revenue, and accounting.
* Ability to troubleshoot cross‑platform data flow issues with technical teams.

**5\) Platform, Tools \& Automation Exposure**

* Functional exposure to **Dataverse‑based architecture** underpinning Project Operations.
* Working knowledge of:
* **Power Platform** (Power Automate for approvals, alerts; Power BI for project and resource reporting)
* Integration with **Microsoft Project for the Web** for planning and scheduling
* Ability to identify **automation opportunities** within project and HR processes and guide governed implementation.

**6\) Testing, Training \& Change Enablement**

* Lead and support **SIT and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**.
* Prepare test scenarios, test cases, and validation checklists.
* Create user documentation, SOPs, and training material.
* Conduct **end‑user and administrator training sessions** and ensure adoption readiness.

**7\) Delivery Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the **functional lead** for Project Operations and HR workstreams.
* Collaborate closely with:
* Technical architects and developers
* Finance and HR teams
* Program and project managers
* Serve as the primary functional point of contact for senior stakeholders, translating business objectives into system outcomes.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

**Must‑Have**

* Strong hands‑on experience with **D365 Project Operations**.
* Functional exposure to **Dynamics 365 HR / Human Resources**.
* Proven experience in **full‑lifecycle D365 implementations** (design to post‑go‑live).
* Strong understanding of:
* Project management methodologies
* Project accounting and revenue recognition
* Resource staffing and utilization
* Ability to bridge **business, functional, and technical teams** effectively.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in **professional services, IT services, or project‑centric organizations**.
* Exposure to **multi‑entity or global project delivery models**.
* Reporting exposure using **Power BI / project analytics**.

**Education \& Certifications (Preferred)**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Business, IT, Finance, or related field**.
* Microsoft certifications (preferred):
* **Dynamics 365 Project Operations Functional Consultant**

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Lead‑level consultant with strong ownership mindset.

description:
**Job Description – Finance Manager**

Department \- Finance \& Accounts

Experience Required \- 8 – 12 Years

Industry Preference \- Construction / Architecture / Interior Design / Real Estate

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented Finance Manager with 8–12 years of experience in the construction, architecture, and interior design industry. The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall financial operations of the organization, leading the finance team, ensuring financial compliance, budgeting, cost control, project finance management, and supporting strategic business decisions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, financial planning expertise, and experience in handling project\-based financial operations within the construction and design sector.

**Key Duties \& Responsibilities**

1\*. Financial Planning \& Budget Management\*

Prepare annual budgets, financial forecasts, and project cost plans.

Monitor organizational financial performance and control project expenditures.

Analyze budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

Support management with strategic financial planning and decision\-making.

2\. Accounting \& Financial Operations

Oversee daily accounting operations, bookkeeping, and financial transactions.

Ensure accurate maintenance of ledgers, invoices, payments, and financial records.

Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

Manage cash flow, banking operations, and fund utilization efficiently.

3\. Project Finance \& Cost Control

Monitor project\-wise costing, profitability, and financial performance.

Ensure proper tracking of construction and interior project expenses.

Control operational costs and optimize financial resources.

Coordinate with project teams regarding project budgets and financial approvals.

4\. Team Leadership \& Management

Lead, supervise, and manage the finance and accounts team effectively.

Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of financial tasks.

Provide guidance, performance monitoring, and team development support.

Ensure coordination between finance, procurement, HR, and project departments.

5\. Compliance \& Audit Management

Ensure compliance with financial regulations, taxation, and statutory requirements.

Handle GST, TDS, payroll compliance, and other financial statutory processes.

Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely audit closure.

Maintain proper financial documentation and compliance records.

6\. Reporting \& Financial Analysis

Prepare MIS reports, financial dashboards, and management reports.

Present financial insights and profitability analysis to senior management.

Monitor financial risks and recommend process improvements.

Ensure accurate reporting of project revenue, expenses, and cash flow.

7\. Vendor \& Payment Management

Monitor vendor payments, subcontractor billing, and payment schedules.

Verify payment approvals as per project and financial policies.

Maintain healthy financial relationships with vendors and suppliers.

Ensure proper reconciliation of accounts payable and receivable.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial management.

Expertise in project finance, budgeting, and cost control.

Knowledge of GST, taxation, statutory compliance, and audit procedures.

Strong analytical, leadership, and decision\-making skills.

Excellent communication and team management abilities.

Proficiency in Tally, ERP systems, MS Excel, and financial reporting tools.

**Educational Qualification**

CA / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com with relevant experience.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Experience in construction, architecture, interior design, or project\-based industries.

Ability to manage multiple projects and financial operations simultaneously.

Strong leadership experience in handling finance and accounts teams.

High attention to detail, confidentiality, and organizational skills.

title: Lead Specialist, Payroll - APAC
description:
**Job Description:**

We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.


**About the Role:**

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Payroll, the Lead Specialist, Payroll \- APAC will be responsible for managing payroll operations across multiple APAC countries. This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll processing while partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver a seamless employee experience.


You will work closely with HR, Finance, and global stakeholders to drive process improvements, ensure regulatory compliance, and support payroll operations aligned with organizational standards.


**How you will make an impact**

* Manage end\-to\-end payroll processing across APAC regions, ensuring accuracy and timeliness across all components including base pay, stock compensation, taxes, and statutory benefits
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities, including reviewing and approving journal entries
* Partner with HR, Finance, and Employee Services teams to ensure seamless payroll experience
* Drive process improvements and efficiencies to enhance payroll accuracy and consistency
* Ensure compliance with local statutory requirements and support payroll\-related regulatory filings
* Support payroll set\-up and implementation for new countries/entities and ongoing system implementations (e.g., Celergo)
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve payroll\-related queries and issues

**What we are looking for**

* 8–9 years of experience in payroll, with strong exposure to APAC payroll operations
* Strong knowledge of payroll across APAC countries such as China, Singapore, Japan, Australia, Taiwan, Korea, Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end global payroll processes
* Experience with payroll systems, preferably ADP tools (Celergo, Global View, etc.)
* Good understanding of payroll accounting, compliance, and internal controls
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work across time zones and manage multiple priorities effectively

**We power infinite possibilities.**

For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.  



We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.


Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.
  

  

Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance.
  

  

We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. Our values support courageous teammates, needle movers, and learning champions all while striving to support the health and well\-being of all employees. We offer meeting\-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.
  

  

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies. Wiley proactively displays target base pay range for United Kingdom, Canada and USA based roles.
  

  

When applying, please attach your resume/CV to be considered.

==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\)** **Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
===========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5****) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
====================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
Job Summary

The Senior HR Executive is responsible for managing day\-to\-day Human Resources operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll support, statutory compliance, attendance management, performance management, training coordination, HR documentation, and employee engagement. The role ensures compliance with hospital policies, labour laws, and NABH standards while supporting organizational goals through effective HR practices.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Coordinate manpower requisitions with department heads.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, consultants, and employee referrals.
* Screen resumes and schedule interviews.
* Coordinate interview panels and maintain recruitment records.
* Conduct reference and background verification.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and joining documentation.
* Ensure smooth onboarding and induction of new employees.

2\. Employee Onboarding \& Documentation

* Complete joining formalities and employee file creation.
* Maintain personal files with all mandatory documents.
* Update employee records in the HRMS.
* Issue employee ID cards and employment\-related letters.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee records.

3\. Attendance \& Leave Management

* Monitor daily attendance through biometric systems.
* Verify attendance discrepancies with department heads.
* Process leave applications and maintain leave records.
* Prepare attendance reports for payroll processing.
* Monitor absenteeism and late\-coming.

4\. Payroll \& Compensation Support

* Prepare monthly payroll inputs.
* Verify attendance, leave, overtime, and statutory deductions.
* Coordinate salary processing with Finance/Payroll.
* Resolve employee salary\-related queries.
* Maintain payroll documentation.

5\. Statutory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with PF, ESI, Labour Welfare Fund, Professional Tax, Bonus, and Gratuity regulations.
* Maintain statutory registers and records.
* Coordinate statutory inspections and audits.
* Assist in labour law compliance and documentation.

6\. Employee Relations

* Address employee grievances professionally.
* Support disciplinary proceedings.
* Draft warning letters, memos, and show\-cause notices.
* Promote positive employee relations.
* Ensure adherence to the Code of Conduct.

7\. Performance Management

* Coordinate probation evaluations.
* Assist in annual performance appraisals.
* Maintain appraisal documentation.
* Track employee confirmation and promotions.

8\. Training \& Development

* Coordinate induction programmes.
* Organize internal and external training sessions.
* Maintain training records.
* Assist in Training Need Analysis (TNA).
* Evaluate training effectiveness.

9\. HR Operations \& Compliance

* Maintain HR policies and SOPs.
* Prepare monthly HR MIS reports.
* Support NABH documentation and HR audits.
* Ensure compliance with HR processes and hospital standards.

10\. Employee Engagement

* Organize employee engagement activities.
* Coordinate celebrations and recognition programmes.
* Conduct employee satisfaction surveys.
* Support welfare initiatives.

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Training & Development, Officer
description:
**Who are we looking for**

This position is for an individual contributor in Talent Development \& Learning’s – Global Facilitation team responsible for the Functional trainings for employees in India and several global offices as per the requirement. This person is responsible for delivery and for monitoring the performance of New hire onboarding program for all new hires to the company and for the delivery of advanced skills training globally. The role requires the person to be well versed in the financial services industry, departmental policies and company policies. This position is designed to mitigate the risk of errors in fund administration operations (including accounting, transfer agency, trade processing, reconciliation and financial reporting). Effectiveness as a trainer impacts the employees’ level of preparation for the job and the company’s level of protection against operational error and potential liability. The person will report directly to a AVP Global facilitation team.


**What you will be responsible for**

* The Functional Skills Trainer will be required to master and deliver the Functional onboarding, New Hire curriculums and other financial skills training
* Deliver both traditional classroom training and virtually instructed led training, hands on Functional and systems training, focused on Functional (job\-specific) content training as needed.
* Cross\-train with other trainers and/or business unit staff to teach/learn training program material
* Liaise with subject\-matter experts in the business lines when required to support the development of training materials.
* Attend staff development workshops/seminars to enhance presentation skills and industry knowledge.
* Actively participate in appraisal process by completing a self\-evaluation and suggesting appropriate development.
* Take responsibility for Self\-development in alignment to the teams goal.

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**

* Solid understanding of the Financial Markets / Investment Management and Servicing industry is required, and intimate knowledge of State Street services, systems, processes and procedures is preferred.
* Support the development of new training and or evolve existing training offerings as well as delivering existing materials and add context/content/background to delivery of courses.
* Ability to teach Functional information to employees of all experience levels.
* Ability to work effectively with employees from other departments on training projects and various committees.
* Ability to work as part of a virtual training team spanning several locations/countries, sharing best practices.
* Bachelor’s degree with business, finance, accounting, or education major preferred.
* 10\+ years’ experience in the Financial Services Industry.
* Ability to develop business relationships, both within and outside of the organization.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills including pilot356 and other AI tools.
* Communicate effectively at all levels within the organization, foster collaboration \& team work.

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.


**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.


**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.


State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.


Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers


**About State Street**

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: DevOps Trainer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are hiring a DevOps Trainer to deliver our DevOps, Cloud, CI/CD, and containerisation training programs. You will help students understand modern software delivery from source control and Linux fundamentals to Docker, Kubernetes, automation, monitoring, and cloud deployment. Whether you are a bright fresher with strong project work or a professional with up to 2 years of experience, if you love teaching and can make infrastructure concepts practical and simple, we want to hear from you \- structured trainer onboarding will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver engaging classroom and online training sessions in Linux fundamentals, networking basics, Git/GitHub, and shell scripting
* Teach DevOps culture, SDLC, Agile workflows, build/release practices, and production deployment concepts
* Cover Linux server administration basics including users, permissions, services, processes, SSH, package management, logs, and cron jobs
* Train students in Docker \- images, containers, Dockerfiles, volumes, networks, registries, and Docker Compose
* Cover Kubernetes fundamentals including pods, deployments, services, config maps, secrets, ingress, and basic troubleshooting
* Teach Nginx or Apache basics for reverse proxy, static hosting, SSL configuration, and application routing
* Teach CI/CD pipeline creation using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI, including automated build, test, and deployment stages
* Introduce build tools and artifact handling for common stacks, including Maven/Gradle, npm builds, Docker image tagging, and registry usage
* Introduce cloud concepts and hands\-on deployment using AWS or Azure services such as compute, storage, IAM, VPC/VNet, security groups, load balancing, and basic server management
* Cover Infrastructure as Code and automation basics using Terraform and Ansible
* Teach cloud and DevOps security basics including IAM permissions, secrets management, SSH key handling, environment variables, vulnerability scanning, and least\-privilege access
* Teach monitoring, logging, and alerting fundamentals using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or cloud\-native monitoring
* Guide students through real deployment projects such as hosting a web app on cloud, containerising an application, building a CI/CD pipeline, deploying
* to Kubernetes, and setting up basic monitoring
* Prepare and update course materials, lab exercises, assessments, and project briefs in line with industry trends
* Mentor students on resume building, GitHub portfolios, project explanation, and DevOps interview preparation
* Evaluate student progress, run doubt\-clearing sessions, and support academy demos, workshops, and seminars

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field
* 0\-2 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, system administration, software development, or technical training
* Strong understanding of Linux, networking basics, Git/GitHub, and shell scripting
* Ability to teach Linux server administration, SSH, permissions, services, logs, cron, and basic troubleshooting
* Hands\-on knowledge of Docker and containerised application deployment
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes fundamentals and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI
* Familiarity with AWS or Azure cloud services, IAM, networking, security groups, load balancers, and deployment workflows
* Basic exposure to Nginx/Apache, Terraform, Ansible, monitoring tools, and DevOps security practices is preferred
* A portfolio of DevOps projects, GitHub repositories, cloud deployments, CI/CD pipelines, or automation scripts is highly preferred
* Excellent presentation and communication skills in English; Malayalam is an advantage
* Genuine passion for teaching and mentoring students, and for staying current with DevOps, cloud, and Gen AI automation tools

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with growth into senior trainer roles
* Continuous upskilling in the latest DevOps, cloud, Kubernetes, automation, and Gen AI tools
* A platform to build your personal brand as a technology educator, in a supportive, learning\-focused culture

**About Us**

SMEC Technologies is Kerala's leading IT training academy, backed by over 25 years of parent\-company experience in engineering and industrial solutions. With centres in Kochi, Calicut, and Trivandrum, we deliver industry\-focused programs in Full Stack Development, Data Science, AI \& ML, Software Testing, UI/UX Design, Cloud, and DevOps \- all with Gen AI integration and placement assistance.

**Job \#:** req37818
  

**Organization:** World Bank Group
  

**Sector:** Procurement
  

**Grade:** GH
  

**Term Duration:** 4 years 0 months  


**Recruitment Type:** International Recruitment
  

**Location:** Washington, DC, United States, Chennai, India or Sofia, Bulgaria
  

**Required Language(s):** English
  

**Preferred Language(s):**
  

**Closing Date:** 8/11/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  

**Description**

**Note:** “This vacancy announcement is for one position posted across multiple possible duty stations. That includes Washington D.C and Sofia and Chennai. The selected candidate's duty station will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs. If the selection is based in Washington, DC, the recruitment type will be International and if the selection is based in Sofia or Chennai, the recruitment type will be Local.”

  

The World Bank Group is a unique global partnership of five institutions driven by a bold vision to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet. As one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries, we help solve the world’s greatest development challenges. When you join the World Bank Group, you become part of a dynamic, diverse organization with 189 member countries and 182 offices worldwide. We work with public and private sector partners, invest in groundbreaking projects, and use data, research, and technology to bring tangible and transformative change around the globe. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org


**Vice\-Presidency Context**


The WBG Budget and Procurement (WBP) is organized into five Departments: WBP Centers of Excellence (WBPCE) with teams supporting the corporate strategic business and budget planning process, providing WBP systems, knowledge, and shared services; WBP IBRD/IDA Regional Units (WBPRU) with teams supporting IBRD/IDA clients in the regions; WBP IFC/MIGA Budget Partners (CSRDR) with teams supporting IFC/MIGA clients in the HQ and the regions; WBP Corporate Units (WBPCU) with teams supporting the Knowledge Bank and corporate units and providing capital budget support; and WBP Corporate Procurement (WBPCP) with teams providing group\-wide procurement services.


**Unit Context**


Steps to continue evolving the management structure of WBPCP with its strategic priorities present the opportunity to recruit for an expanded managerial role in the Department. In line with the WBP global footprint strategy and delivery model, the location of the positions may be Washington D.C., Chennai, or Sofia. In accordance with World Bank Group policy, positions in Country Offices, irrespective of level, are subject to local recruitment. Selections to positions outside of Washington D.C. will be LRS. Business needs and candidate preference will be considered in determining the actual location of each of the positions described below:


Manager, Procurement Operations \& Advisory is responsible for all operational and advisory functions within the Corporate Procurement department. These include the Corporate Procurement Service Desk, Order Management, Vendor Management, governance monitoring, systems support and administration, and regional procurement advisory, amongst others. Manages a global team of 35 staff based in the HQ, Global Business Centers (GBC), and in each of the seven regions of the WBG to support the decentralized footprint of WBG clients.


**Duties and accountabilities:**


Manager, WBPPS has the following three areas of responsibility:


**A)Business Management Responsibilities**


* Manage the teams providing planning, budgeting, and performance reporting services; conducting analytical work and providing advisory services in areas of focus (e.g., operations, investments in technology); and providing other services as needed over time.


* Is an active member of the WBP Leadership Team, participates in cross cutting activities, and from time to time, takes on leadership roles in WBP\-wide activities, such as recruitment and other HR initiatives.


* Provides support and advice to the Vice President and the Director of WBP, Corporate Procurement as requested.


**B)Talent Management Responsibilities**


* Manages the unit staff, including recruitment, evaluation, and career development of staff.


* Provides leadership and support to her/his staff to build sustainable finance skills and capacity to effectively deliver WBP services.


* Manages and oversees the engagement and evaluation of technical consultants within the WBPCP unit, as needed.


**C)Budget Management Responsibilities**


* Effectively and efficiently manages his/her unit’s resources, ensuring its effective formulation and input into budget decisions.


* Advocates and drives cost\-effective delivery of business finance services, promoting transparency, simplicity, standardization, and automation.

**Selection Criteria**


The successful candidate should be recognized for an ability to get things done, strategic thinking and execution leadership, reputation and track record leading large business transformation initiatives, being a problem\-solver, and possessing accomplishments relevant to the WBG’s strategic agenda.


The successful candidate will have an active interest in the activities of the World Bank Group, its mission, products and services in addition to having a strong work ethics and unquestionable integrity, and should possess strong leadership in multicultural environment, and analytical abilities as well as excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills adaptable to all audiences, including Board level.


The candidate should have a minimum of a Master’s degree in relevant field/discipline (e.g., Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law, etc.), coupled with a minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in procurement, with a strong track record of success in leading and managing complex procurement operations.


The ideal candidate should also possess as many of the following professional and personal characteristics as possible:


* Deep understanding of procurement principles, practices, and regulations, including international procurement standards.


* Strong strategic orientation and ability to manage successfully large work programs and extensively decentralized teams.


* Demonstrated ability to conceptualize complex issues with future focused systematic thinking and frame problems as actionable issues with ability to develop consensus among diverse constituents.


* Proven ability to balance client concerns with wider corporate concerns as well as proven ability to interact effectively with WBG and external counterparts.


* Proven change integrator with ability to effectively lead and implement complex change management initiatives.


* Strong understanding of the workings of the organizational context including the matrix environment with deep functional knowledge of the challenges of resource deployment in Operations.


* Demonstrated effectiveness in collaboration across the Organization including Operations and Corporate functions and proven ability to build common goals and solutions while managing different views.


WBG Managerial Competencies

**WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.



**POSITION SUMMARY**  

We're looking for a highly creative and self\-motivated Senior Product Designer to join EarnIn's Financial Intelligence Platform team. This is a structured, quality\-focused group responsible for designing and improving the foundational experiences that power EarnIn's modern platform for financial flexibility and financial wellness for its community members. You'll work closely with product, engineering, design, compliance, risk, and finance partners to define and drive design excellence across core features like bank connectivity, earnings tracking, and repayment experiences. This role bridges deep design leadership with cross\-functional execution, championing both customer and business value while ensuring quality, simplicity, and regulatory compliance. Your work will directly influence customer satisfaction and retention across our core experiences.

This position will be a hybrid role based in our Bengaluru office, with 2 days on\-site as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Palo Alto HQ. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
* Design and refine core experiences across the full customer journey—from bank connection and account setup to earnings tracking and repayment experiences
* Partner with PMs, engineering, and data teams to define design requirements and validate solutions through research and usability testing
* Establish and maintain design patterns and systems that ensure consistency and simplicity across Financial Intelligence Platform features
* Identify friction points in critical flows and design thoughtful solutions that improve usability, clarity, confidence, and compliance
* Leverage research findings and customer feedback to inform design strategy and prioritize improvements that deliver measurable impact
* Champion quality and polish, ensuring every interaction reflects EarnIn's commitment to reliability, trust, and regulatory standards
* Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, and Finance teams to ensure designs meet industry and regulatory requirements
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and design excellence within the team

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
* 7\+ years of experience designing consumer\-facing digital products, with demonstrated success on core experiences or core functionality
* A strong portfolio showcasing thoughtful problem\-solving, systematic design, and measurable improvements to user satisfaction and retention
* Deep understanding of financial products, user trust, and how to design for clarity in complex workflows
* Ability to balance creative thinking with research\-driven validation, comfortable collaborating with data teams to measure impact
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills, particularly in articulating design rationale to cross\-functional stakeholders at all levels
* Skilled in Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design workflows
* Comfortable in structured environments where roadmaps are planned across product areas, with the ability to drive projects to completion

title: APAC Benefits Coordinator
description:
Barracuda is looking for a Regional Employee Benefits Manager to support the accurate, compliant and employee\-focused delivery of benefit programs across assigned countries. This role combines operational benefits administration, employee support, vendor coordination and process discipline to deliver a consistent benefits experience aligned with regional requirements and globalb benefits standards.


This role will act as the first point of contact for employee and manager inquiries related to benefits and will primarily support APAC plan operations and employee lifecycle events. The role will work closely with the Director, Global Benefits and brokers/consultants, who will retain ownership of plan strategy, renewals, and vendor management.


This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys operational excellence, employee interaction, and building scalable processes in a global environment.

**What You’ll Be Working On**

* **Administer regional benefits programmes**: Deliver day\-to\-day administration for health, wellbeing, retirement, insurance, leave and other employee benefit programmes across assigned countries or markets.
* **Manage enrolment and employee changes**: Process benefit enrolments, life event changes, eligibility updates, employee contributions and data submissions in partnership with HR Operations, Payroll and external providers.
* **Resolve employee and HR enquiries**: Serve as a point of contact for benefits questions, providing clear guidance to employees, managers and HR partners and escalating complex or sensitive matters where needed.
* **Coordinate vendors and brokers**: Work with benefit providers, brokers and internal stakeholders to resolve service issues, track deliverables, support renewals and maintain reliable service delivery.
* **Maintain compliance and governance**: Keep accurate records, support audits, monitor local statutory and regulatory requirements, and help ensure plans are administered in line with company policy and regional obligations.
* **Support communications and continuous improvement**: Contribute to employee communications, open enrolment activities, reporting and process improvements that increase benefits awareness, engagement and operational effectiveness.

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field; or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of experience in benefits administration, HR operations, or a similar support role
* Experience supporting APAC benefits programs or working in a multi\-country environment strongly preferred (Australia, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, and India)
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in data management
* Customer\-first mindset with a strong commitment to delivering excellent employee support
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively in a fast\-paced, global environment
* Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information simply
* Experience working with HRIS systems and ticketing tools preferred
* Collaborative approach with the ability to work cross\-functionally with HR, Payroll, Finance, and external vendors

 **Scope \& Role Clarity**

* This role is focused on operations, administration, and Tier 1 support
* Plan design, renewals, and vendor strategy will be owned by the Global Benefits team
* The role may expand over time to include additional regional or HR operational support

title: Sr. Manager, Accounting (India)
description:
**About Vercel:**
-----------------



Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what's next.



For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.



Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.



We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like **OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide**. Whether you're building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you'll help define what comes next.

**About the Role:**



Vercel is scaling fast, and the Senior Manager, Accounting will be a critical hire as we build out the financial infrastructure that supports our global growth and path to the public markets. You will own end\-to\-end accounting operations for Vercel's statutory accounting across current and future entities, from monthly close and statutory compliance to audit support and process improvement. Working closely with the Head of Finance, India Center of Excellence, the US\-based Controller and global finance team, you'll bring rigor, ownership, and a builder's mindset to a function that is growing quickly.



This role is fully remote from your home office in India, with regular overlap hours with the US team. You will report to the Head of Finance, CoE who is also based in India.


**What You Will Do:**


* Lead the full\-cycle monthly and quarterly close for Vercel's current and future international entities, setting clear standards for accuracy, completeness, and timeliness in accordance with both local and US GAAP.
* Guide and support accounts payable and accounts receivable teams for correct accounting, manage payroll accounting and intercompany transactions in coordination with the global finance team.
* Own statutory compliance including preparation and supporting filing of FS, auditsTDS/TCS returns,, and coordination with external auditors and tax advisors. Also coordinate with the corporate secretaries for various secretarial compliance.
* Partner with the US\-based Controller and CAO on the global close; prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial statements.
* Partner with SOX leader helping with Design, implement, and evolve SOX\-aligned controls and internal accounting policies for the international entities as the business scales amd execute these controls consistently
* Lead close process improvements and accelerate the closing process; identify automation and AI opportunities, simplify workflows, and build scalable infrastructure for the finance function.
* Own the audit relationship for these international entities; preparing materials, answering auditor questions, and keeping audits running smoothly.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Legal, HR, FP\&A, and Revenue Operations on new business initiatives with accounting implications.
* Mentor and develop junior accounting staff as the CoE team grows.
* Support the US GAAP Accounting for the US based entity(s) as and when required in different areas.
* Help the organization in pre and post merger and acquisition activities such as due diligence, integrating the acquired entities, supporting compliance, data migration, etc.
* Lead the new entities setup in different countries representing the accounting team and having these entities operational.
* Monitor changes in local GAAP, tax, regulatory, and corporate compliance requirements for international entities and ensure timely implementation in accounting processes.
* Support cash, banking, treasury accounting, and foreign exchange accounting matters for international entities, including bank reconciliations, revaluations, realized/unrealized FX, and cash reporting.


**About You:**


* 12\+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 5\+ years in managing a team.
* CA (Chartered Accountant) designation required; CPA or equivalent international qualification is a plus.
* Deep expertise in technical accounting, including IFRS and US GAAP, with the ability to research, interpret, and apply local GAAP, statutory accounting requirements, tax regulations, and regulatory reporting obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems; NetSuite strongly preferred.
* Proven track record managing or supporting Big 4 / top\-tier audits.
* Experience at a high\-growth technology or SaaS company; must have prior exposure to multi\-entity, international accounting structures.
* Process\-minded and curious, with experience leveraging AI, automation, and systems to improve accuracy and efficiency.
* Clear, confident communicator who collaborates effectively across remote, cross\-functional, and cross\-cultural teams.
* Self\-starter who thrives in an async\-first environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable working in a builder environment where processes may be evolving, documentation may need to be created from scratch, and the role requires both strategic thinking and hands\-on execution.


The India annual base pay range for this role is 6,942,000\.00 to 8,678,000\.00 (INR). The total compensation package may include benefits, equity\-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.



Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Reporting \& Coordination

title: HR Partner, Ops Field HRP
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as the front\-line consultants to the business supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They operate independently and are seen as subject matter experts, having deep knowledge in local programs, processes, and policies. They offer strong, credible and compelling advice to business leaders on how to manage their team. They are committed to collaboration with multiple HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees in across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. The HRP team’s role is also to standardize best practices across India, due to our extensive insights across business lines.

 The Human Resources Manager will oversee end\-to\-end HR operations, including talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations for Medigrad’s New Delhi \& Hyderabad office. This full\-time, on\-site role involves developing and implementing HR policies, ensuring compliance with labor laws, and supporting organizational culture and employee engagement initiatives. The individual will collaborate with leadership to identify workforce needs, manage HR data and reporting, and drive learning and development programs aligned with the company’s growth. The Human Resources Manager will also handle compensation and benefits administration, resolve workplace concerns in a fair and confidential manner, and support change management across teams.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong experience in core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Knowledge of HR policies, procedures, and compliance with Indian labor laws and statutory regulations.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to build trust across diverse teams.
* Proven ability to design and implement training, learning and development, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Demonstrated organizational, time\-management, and problem\-solving abilities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; a postgraduate HR qualification or MBA in HR is preferred.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a senior HR generalist role; experience in edtech or healthcare is an advantage.

title: Employee Relations Manager, INOPS EXR
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work reactively on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of HR, talent acquisition, management consulting, or project/program management experience


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: HRIS Specialist
description:

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.  

  



**People Technology Team**  



**What will you contribute?**

At Finastra, we are transforming the way our people experience technology. As an HRIS Specialist within the People Technology team, you will play a key role in supporting and enhancing our global HR technology landscape, centred around Workday and other People systems.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, supporting users, managing system integrations and working across a broad range of HR technology initiatives. You will act as a trusted partner to HR stakeholders and business teams, ensuring our systems operate efficiently and continue to evolve to meet business needs.


**What you'll do**

As an HRIS Specialist, you will be responsible for providing operational support across our People Technology platforms, with a primary focus on integration support and Workday administration.


**Why join Finastra?**

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Experience troubleshooting and resolving HR system or integration issues.**

* **Experience working with ServiceNow or a similar ticketing/service management platform.**

---------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

title: HR Payroll Executive
description:
**HR PAYROLL EXECUTIVE**

Company: **Eltro Cyberchrome Private Limited**  
Location: Chengannur, Alappuzha District, Kerala

Employment Type: Full\-time, Permanent  
Monthly Salary: ₹20,000  
Experience: Minimum 2 years preferred

Working Days: Monday to Saturday  
Office Hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM  
Weekly Off: Sunday

We are looking for a responsible, organised, and experienced HR \& Payroll Executive to manage recruitment, payroll, PF/ESI coordination, employee attendance, staff performance tracking, employee documentation and day\-to\-day human resource operations.

The selected candidate will work from the company’s new office in Chengannur and coordinate directly with employees, management, accountants and statutory compliance consultants.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The HR \& Payroll Executive will support the complete employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, attendance, payroll, statutory documentation, performance monitoring, employee relations and exit formalities.

The ideal candidate should have practical HR and payroll knowledge, excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential employee information professionally.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**(1\)** *Payroll Management*

* Collect and verify monthly attendance, leave, overtime, incentives and salary information
* Prepare and process monthly employee payroll accurately and on time
* Calculate salary, loss of pay, overtime, incentives, reimbursements and deductions
* Prepare monthly salary sheets and employee payslips
* Verify employee bank and salary details
* Coordinate with the accounts department for salary disbursement
* Maintain payroll registers and month\-wise salary records
* Respond to employee salary queries professionally
* Submit the final payroll statement to management for approval
* Maintain complete confidentiality of employee salary information

**(2\)** *PF, ESI and Statutory Coordination*

* Calculate employee and employer PF/ESI contributions, where applicable
* Maintain employee UAN, PF, ESI and KYC records
* Support new\-employee UAN and statutory registrations
* Update employee details in statutory records
* Prepare information required for monthly PF/ESI challans and returns
* Coordinate monthly filings and payments with the accountant or compliance consultant
* Maintain copies of challans, returns and related compliance documents
* Assist employees with routine PF, UAN and ESI queries
* Monitor monthly statutory deadlines
* Report missing documents or compliance concerns to management

**(3\)** *Attendance and Leave Management*

* Monitor employees’ daily attendance and working hours
* Maintain login, logout, late arrival and early departure records
* Record employee absences and approved leave
* Review leave applications and obtain the necessary approval
* Maintain individual leave balances
* Follow up regarding missing attendance or unauthorised absence
* Calculate loss of pay according to company policy
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly attendance reports
* Maintain holiday and weekly\-off records

**(4\)** *Staff Monitoring and Performance Tracking*

* Collect daily or weekly work reports from employees
* Maintain department\-wise task and performance trackers
* Monitor assigned duties, deadlines and task\-completion status
* Follow up on delayed, incomplete or unreported work
* Monitor punctuality, responsiveness and workplace discipline
* Prepare weekly and monthly employee performance reports
* Coordinate performance\-review meetings
* Document performance feedback and improvement requirements
* Report repeated attendance, discipline or performance concerns to management
* Ensure monitoring is based on attendance, assigned responsibilities and measurable work output

**(5\)** *Recruitment and Selection*

* Discuss manpower requirements with management
* Prepare job descriptions for approved vacancies
* Publish advertisements on Indeed, LinkedIn, Naukri and other authorised platforms
* Source candidates through job portals, social media and referrals
* Review CVs and shortlist suitable candidates
* Conduct preliminary telephone or in\-person HR interviews
* Evaluate candidates’ qualifications, experience, communication and availability
* Schedule final interviews with management
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview status
* Conduct reference or previous\-employment checks when authorised
* Communicate offers within the salary approved by management
* Maintain an accurate recruitment tracker
* Prepare weekly recruitment\-status reports

**(6\)** *Employee Onboarding*

* Prepare approved offer letters and appointment letters
* Collect identity, address, education, employment and bank documents
* Verify that required joining documents have been submitted
* Create individual employee files
* Complete payroll, PF, ESI and employee\-record formalities
* Conduct employee induction and orientation
* Explain office hours, attendance, leave, reporting and company policies
* Coordinate employee email, system and workplace access
* Update the employee master database
* Follow up with new employees during probation

**(7\)** *Employee Records and HR Documentation*

* Maintain complete physical and digital employee files
* Keep the employee master database accurate and updated
* Maintain copies of employment contracts and employee correspondence
* Prepare confirmation, increment and designation\-change letters
* Prepare approved warning, show\-cause and disciplinary letters
* Issue salary certificates and other authorised HR documents
* Maintain records of management approvals
* Update changes in salary, designation, department and reporting manager
* Ensure employee records are securely stored
* Protect confidential employee and company information

**(8\)** *Employee Relations*

* Serve as the first point of contact for routine employee HR queries
* Communicate company policies and management instructions
* Receive and document employee grievances
* Escalate serious or sensitive matters to management
* Support the professional resolution of workplace concerns
* Maintain confidentiality when handling employee complaints
* Encourage professional conduct and respectful communication
* Coordinate employee announcements, meetings and engagement activities

**(9\)** *HR Policies and Workplace Discipline*

* Assist management in preparing and updating basic HR policies
* Communicate approved policies to employees
* Collect employee acknowledgement of important policies
* Monitor compliance with attendance, leave and reporting procedures
* Document workplace misconduct and policy violations
* Prepare authorised notices and warnings
* Maintain records of disciplinary action and employee responses
* Ensure that major disciplinary decisions receive management approval

**(10\)** *Performance Review and Development*

* Maintain employee goals and performance indicators
* Coordinate probation and periodic performance reviews
* Collect performance feedback from reporting managers
* Prepare performance\-review summaries
* Track probation confirmation and salary\-review dates
* Monitor approved performance\-improvement plans
* Follow up on employee improvement actions
* Identify basic training requirements
* Coordinate employee training and development activities
* Maintain training and performance records

**(11\)** *Resignation and Exit Formalities*

* Receive and acknowledge employee resignations
* Verify the applicable notice period
* Coordinate work handover and department clearance
* Ensure the return of company property and documents
* Coordinate deactivation of company access
* Conduct or coordinate exit interviews
* Prepare an employee exit summary
* Provide payroll information for final settlement
* Coordinate full\-and\-final settlement with accounts and management
* Prepare approved experience and relieving letters
* Update the employee master database and exit records

**(12\)** *HR Reports and Management Support*

* Prepare daily attendance reports
* Prepare weekly recruitment and staff\-status reports
* Prepare monthly payroll, leave and compliance reports
* Maintain recruitment, onboarding, performance and exit trackers
* Highlight pending approvals and statutory deadlines
* Report important employee concerns to management
* Support management with HR and related administrative activities

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

If you would like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. Workforce Staffing (WFS), a division of Worldwide Operations People, Product \& Tech, manages Amazon’s Tier 1 talent (Front\-line associates) supply chain. We attract, hire, and onboard the associates who, by fulfilling orders at the frontlines of the company, make Amazon a global leader in delivery and logistics. * Experience communicating complex concepts clearly and persuasively to different audiences


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
* Master's degree or MBA in Supply Chain, Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related quantitative field
