title: Associate Director - Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL
description:
**Job title:** **Associate Director – Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL**

 **Some careers have more impact than others.**


If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Associate Director – Financial Crime Detection RISK AND CTRL.**

**In this role, you will:**

* Analyze data assets and generate insights aligned with business outcomes and strategic data models. Gather, understand data requirements from stakeholders to design and deliver analytics use cases (e.g. triggers). Deliver analytics PoCs that allow our businesses and clients to identify new opportunities. Responsible to address business challenges in an actionable way by leveraging current and emerging data and analytical techniques.
* Proactively identify opportunities to derive higher returns with improved Data Quality. Review and identify data inconsistencies across consuming systems. Responsible for providing management and direction to cross\-functional experts (pods) from analytics, technology, transformation and product management and key stakeholders across global functions and regions. Ensure implementation of consistent and effective management approach across the functional areas.
* Interface within the Detection Value Stream for all Change and Prioritization matters. Provide guidance and support to Leadership in the delivery of investment across technology, intelligence, and analytics to enhance the efficiency, effectiveness, security and cost profile of FC. Support and provide guidance in developing, driving and implementing programmes to quantify impacts and implement actions to address, manage and mitigate impacts of FC related regulatory changes across the FC control framework. Develop and Manage relationships with key internal stakeholders across Group functions, lines of business, regions, and countries.
* Facilitate the sharing of information and creation of feedback loops across the firm, with particular focus on wider FC Detection stakeholders to continuously adapt and improve change management and optimization. Overseas the support and coordination capability necessary to manage the response to high priority FC Detection Feedback requiring a coordinated response across Group Financial Crime functions, Compliance, lines of business, regions, or countries. Develop and maintain a strong and professional working relationship with Senior Management of FC, Risk, Audit and Finance at Business, Group and Regional levels
* Ensure appropriate timely and relevant risk information is provided to FC leadership and appropriate governance forums. Drive the articulation and embedding of FC Detection Optimization controls. Ensure that these are updated for changes in regulation and impacts on business. Resolve any identified issues promptly and escalate concerns to management as appropriate to ensure timely awareness of any material concerns.
* Maintain and observe all HSBC control standards and implement relevant policies, including the timely implementation of recommendations made by internal / external auditors and external regulators. Where required, support the articulation and embedding of framework, policies, procedures, and controls as they relate to FC Controls. Maintain awareness of operational risk within the value stream and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.
* Develop and present options to implement controls whilst retaining full benefit from investment in systems. Clearly communicate and effectively implement the Change Management and Prioritization strategy to meet business needs. Provide direction at a global level and support at a regional level with respect to the FC Detection change and prioritization processes.
* Influence through action and strong leadership with respect to establishing an effective and efficient Risk Discovery Environment, deliver very strong collaboration and influencing across the Compliance matrix. Provide sponsorship and strategic vision for People Development initiatives aligned to Financial Crime, Compliance, and Group activities, as well as supporting the annual BAU HR cycle. Ensure effective communication across Financial Crime and the business to all key stakeholders in relation to FC Detection matters
* Support the sharing of developments and best practice across the wider FC Function. Support delivers the value stream approach aligned to detection outcomes to deliver a seamless integration of cross\-functional expertise. Maintain and develop positive and professional working relationships with senior business leaders, Risk and Compliance colleagues at Group, Regional and Market / Entity level
* Work effectively as part of a team, taking the lead where appropriate and contributing to team output and collaboration. Foster learning agile culture, promoting proactive review of lessons learned. Support an inclusive environment that supports diversity and reflects the HSBC brand. Ensures effective and open communication, team building, knowledge sharing, coaching and mentoring not only within the function but to the broader organization

**To be successful you will:**

* Strong understanding of Global Financial Crime landscape and the various risk typologies and having good visibility to the eminent changes in landscape.
* Existing Financial Crime Detection capabilities and the limitations therein.
* Awareness of technological advancements in Financial Crime detection capabilities.
* HSBC is an extremely diverse business with significant geographical spread and activities that span a universal banking model, including continuing to innovate to keep abreast of changes in financial services markets globally. Such activity is in an increasingly regulated and complex global environment with often little consistency between laws and regulations in different jurisdictions and regulators taking a far more proactive approach in ensuring local compliance with their requirements and imposing increasingly stringent sanctions for breaches.
* The role will assist the Group in achieving a balance between the demands of regulators, external bodies and governmental initiatives and the Group’s shareholders and customers in enacting FC compliance; being alive to the political, management, regulatory and reputational implications of a particular decision and courses of action at a global level; assisting executive management in the development of controls and systems and influencing the way in which the business is conducted in order to manage these risks, meeting Group risk appetite. The increased focus on individual liability for senior managers, particularly Risk Heads, makes it increasingly important for the Group to be able to provide adequate systems and controls. The role is one where regulatory authority have high expectations and is likely to come under scrutiny as part of any major regulatory investigation.

 **You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

  

Hsbc.com/careers

  

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible work and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified people irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Sr. Financial Analyst
description:
**Role description** **Who We Are:**



Vista’s CFO Organization empowers teams to focus on their domain and serve customers. Clear guardrails pave the way for strong engagement and efficiency in our lines of business, regional operations, and central functions. Team members work cross\-functionally, impacting every area of the company – from human resources, communications and real estate to finance, controllership, and legal services. The CFO team makes critical capabilities accessible, delivering services and information that every employee needs to succeed in their role.



Positioning ourselves centrally and globally, we offer opportunities to scale processes and ideas, facilitate feedback loops across Vista’s organizations and build a team of world\-class talent, with specialized skill sets.



**What You Will Do:**



Vista is building a world\-class finance organization, and we are seeking a highly motivated Senior Financial Analyst to join the FP\&A team. This role will have two main responsibilities –



* Provide finance support for one of our regions. Responsibilities include:


* Perform financial reporting and analysis including:
* Analyze and interpret data to understand key drivers of the financial results to drive actionable insights
* Prepare standardized reports and written analysis for weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews for finance leadership and other key stakeholders
* Drive reporting and process improvements with key users and stakeholders
* Drive our management reporting activities including:
* Drive the annual budget and forecasting processes
* Drive the month\-end close process including review of accounting entries, trends, and operating expenses
* Be a proficient user of Vista’s financial reporting tools
* Communicate across the global finance organization and corporate stakeholders
* Complete ad hoc analysis and other projects as needed.

2\. As a part of FP\&A Centre of Excellence


* Collaborate and work cross\-functionally to improve, standardize, and automate processes leveraging AI and other advanced tools.
* Utilize AI tools \& data visualization for business insights
* Proactively contribute to the team projects along with the regional requirements

This remote\-first position will be based in Bengaluru, India and report to FP\&A Manager.

  


**Your Qualifications:**



At Vista, we value the experiences that individual team members add to our culture. Please don't hesitate to apply even if you don't meet the exact qualifications, we look forward to learning more about you!


* Previous experience working in a high performing team
* Ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast\-paced environment
* Intellectual curiosity and comfort driving progress independently
* Strong understanding of financial statements and profitability drivers
* Fluent in English and excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Experience with Data Visualization Tools (i.e. Tableau, Looker) and advanced Excel skills
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or similar field. CA preferred.
* 3\-5\+ years progressive work experience in FP\&A or similar field

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**



Being at Vista means that you dn’t see work as just a building, a desk, or a manufacturing floor. You see it as a chance to take a step forward in your career journey – and your life. We strive to give you everything you need to learn, grow, and succeed. Through innovation, collaboration, and perpetual exposure to what’s next, we are always pushing boundaries and broadening our horizons. We embrace the chance to operate outside of our comfort zone to discover what we are capable of. Some might call that a challenge; we just call it another great day at work.



Vista has received numerous recognitions including a perfect score of 100 on the Human Rights Campaign Foundation’s 2021 Corporate Equality Index (CEI) naming us a Best Places to Work for LGBTQ Equality. We also earned a place as one of the best remote\-first workplaces in the U.S. and on the Boston Best Places to Work list from Built In. In addition, Vista was recently honored with Comparably’s Best CEOs award according to employees. Vista offers numerous support systems including Employee Resource Groups like Pride, Mosaic, and Women in Technology, and special interest communities to foster awareness, respect, and inclusion within the workplace.



**We are Remote\-First:**



In 2020, Vista adopted a Remote\-First operating model and culture. We heard from our team members that having the freedom, autonomy, and trust in each other to work from home and the ability to operate when they are most productive, empowers them to be their best. Vista also provides collaboration spaces for team members to work physically together when it's safe to do so and when in\-person collaboration will deliver the best results. Currently we are enabled to hire remote team members in over 30\+ US States as well as several countries in Europe, including Spain, Germany, UK, Czech Republic, the Netherlands, Ireland and Switzerland.



**About Us:**



As an e\-commerce powerhouse, Vista creates customer value (and delight) through accessible, cutting\-edge technology. We are the marketing partner to millions of small businesses around the world. For more than 20 years, we have helped small businesses look and feel credible through high\-quality marketing products and solutions that include signage, logo apparel, promotional products, face masks, flyers, postcards, business cards, websites and digital marketing. With Vista, small businesses are able to create and customize their marketing with easy\-to\-use digital tools and design\-templates, or by receiving expert graphic design support. In 2020, Vista acquired 99designs to expand its design offering via a worldwide community of more than 150,000 talented designers to make it easy for designers and clients to work together to create designs they love. Vista is focused on making great marketing and design accessible to every small business owner, allowing them to create a cohesive brand image for use in\-store, online and on\-the\-go.



**Equal Opportunity Employer:**



Vista, a Cimpress company, is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. This list is not exhaustive and, in fact, in many cases, we strive to do more than the law requires.

 **Skills**  

FP\&A, forecasting, data visualization tools

 **About Cimpress**  

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer\-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end\-to\-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500\+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long\-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.

title: Payroll Operations Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**


Executes end\-to\-end payroll processes for assigned countries or employee populations. Reviews and validates payroll inputs, ensures payroll accuracy and compliance with local legislation, responds to employee and stakeholder inquiries, and partners with internal teams and external payroll providers to deliver timely payroll services. Contributes to continuous improvement and standardization initiatives within the Managed Services organization.

**Job Description**

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll processes for assigned countries or employee populations in accordance with payroll calendars and service level agreements.
* Review and validate payroll inputs, including time and attendance, variable pay, employee data changes, and statutory deductions.
* Ensure payroll is processed accurately, timely, and in compliance with company policies and local legislative requirements.
* Review payroll reports and registers to identify and resolve discrepancies before payroll finalization.
* Partner with third\-party payroll providers to ensure accurate payroll processing and timely issue resolution.
* Respond to employee, manager, and stakeholder payroll inquiries, providing timely and professional support.
* Educate and support employees and managers on payroll processes, policies, and Time \& Attendance systems.
* Perform payroll audits and data validation activities to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
* Investigate payroll discrepancies, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Prepare payroll reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation as required.
* Maintain accurate payroll documentation and standard operating procedures for assigned countries.
* processes.

**Experience**

**What We Need**


Corpay is currently looking to hire a Human Resources Manager within our Human Resources department. This position is located in Nagpur, India. Today, we help over 56 million people around the world create great things. Whether you're writing, designing, coding, or collaborating, Quillbot is a place where anyone can create at the speed of thought. Our AI\-powered tools help you think clearly, communicate effectively, and create beautifully—across every platform, in any format, at any skill level. We're seeking a data\-driven and strategic Manager for Paid Media to lead our paid marketing initiatives. You'll work cross\-functionally with other Marketing teams, Data, Engineering, Product and Finance teams to improve our performance

description:
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.**Information Technology \& Digital**
-------------------------------------

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.  

  

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  

  

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.**About the role**
------------------



The IT\&D Manager, IT Service Delivery is accountable for the end\-to\-end service delivery, operational performance, and continual improvement of IT applications and services aligned to a defined Business Capability Stream (e.g. HR, Finance, ERP, Supply, Marketing, R\&D) within a predominantly outsourced operating model.



This role acts as the single point of accountability for service outcomes, ensuring that strategic service providers deliver stable, resilient, secure, and business\-aligned services that meet agreed SLAs, XLAs, and contractual commitments. The role serves as the primary business\-facing IT partner, translating business priorities into operational requirements and orchestrating internal IT teams and multiple suppliers to deliver seamless, high\-quality services.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------



1\. End\-to\-End Service Accountability  

* Own the end\-to\-end operational performance of all applications and services within the assigned capability stream, regardless of supplier or delivery tower.
* Act as the business\-facing service owner, accountable for availability, reliability, performance, and user experience.
* Ensure services are operated as integrated end\-to\-end value streams, not disconnected vendor silos.

  

2\. Supplier \& SIAM\-Oriented Service Orchestration  

* Lead and govern strategic managed service providers, SaaS vendors, and system integrators delivering application and service support.
* Operate as part of a SIAM\-style model, ensuring clear RACI, handoffs, and collaboration across multiple suppliers.
* Hold suppliers accountable for outcomes, not effort, including SLA performance, incident quality, proactive problem prevention, and continuous improvement.

  

3\. Service Performance \& Governance  

* Define, manage, and continuously improve SLAs, XLAs and KPIs aligned to business priorities and critical business events.
* Ensure transparent, accurate, and meaningful reporting focused on:


o Business impact  

o Service stability  

o User experience  

o Root cause and trend insights  

  

4\. Stakeholder \& Business Relationship Management  

* Serve as the primary IT service delivery partner for senior stakeholders within the aligned capability stream.
* Translate business demand, priorities, and pain points into service delivery objectives and supplier commitments.
* Proactively communicate service health, risks, and improvement actions using clear, business\-focused language.
* Represent operational readiness, risk, and service impact in business governance forums.

  

5\. Incident, Major Incident \& Problem Management  

* Ensure robust incident and major incident management across suppliers, including escalation, coordination, and communications.
* Drive Problem Management discipline across vendors, ensuring root causes are identified, recurring issues eliminated, and permanent fixes delivered.
* Hold suppliers accountable for preventable incidents and repeat failures.

  

6\. Change, Release \& Service Transition Oversight  

* Govern supplier\-led change and release activities to balance speed, stability, and risk.
* Accountable for service transition readiness for new systems, enhancements, or supplier changes, including:


o Support models  

o Knowledge transfer  

o Runbooks  

o Monitoring and alerting  

o Service desk enablement  

  

7\. Operational Risk, Resilience \& Compliance  

* Identify and manage service delivery risks across suppliers, including capacity, resilience, security, and compliance.
* Ensure services adhere to internal controls, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.

  

8\. Continual Improvement, Automation \& Efficiency  

* Use incident, problem, and performance data to prioritise improvement initiatives.
* Drive automation, simplification, and standardisation across suppliers to:


o Reduce manual effort  

o Improve stability  

o Lower run costs  

o Enhance user experience  

  

9\. Financial \& Contractual Management (Run Services)  

* Manage run\-state costs associated with the service portfolio, including vendor spend and support contracts.
* Ensure cost transparency and value\-for\-money from service providers.
* Support commercial governance, contract compliance, and service demand prioritisation.
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* Proven experience leading IT service delivery in an outsourced or SIAM\-based environment.
* Strong expertise in ITIL\-based service management (incident, problem, change, service transition, service level management).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple suppliers and drive end\-to\-end service outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with senior business leaders.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise platforms (e.g. SAP, Siebel, SuccessFactors, Oracle, Salesforce, PLM).
* Financial and vendor commercial management experience.
* Exposure to automation, observability, and modern operations practices (AIOps concepts).
* Deep hands\-on experience with ServiceNow as the enterprise IT Service Management platform, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Level Management.
* Understanding of ServiceNow CMDB, service mapping, and dependency modelling to enable true end\-to\-end service ownership.
* Experience defining and governing ITSM workflows, SLAs/XLAs, dashboards, and reporting within ServiceNow, and using ServiceNow data and insights to drive operational performance, problem reduction, and continual service improvement.

  

What Success Looks Like  

* Stable, predictable services with minimal business disruption
* Suppliers operating as one integrated service ecosystem
* Reduced incident volumes and repeat issues
* Clear service ownership and accountability
* Improved business satisfaction and trust in IT delivery

Service Delivery, IT Operations, SIAM, ITIL

title: Manager - Procurement Operations & Advisory (WBPPS)
description:
**Manager \- Procurement Operations \& Advisory (WBPPS)**


**Job \#:** req37779
  

**Organization:** World Bank Group
  

**Sector:** Procurement
  

**Grade:** GH
  

**Term Duration:** 4 years 0 months  


**Recruitment Type:** International Recruitment
  

**Location:** Washington, DC, United States, Chennai, India or Sofia, Bulgaria
  

**Required Language(s):** English
  

**Preferred Language(s):**
  

**Closing Date:** 8/5/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  

**Description**

**Note: Subject to business needs and management approval, the location for this position will either be Sofia, Bulgaria, Chennai, India or Washington, DC**


The World Bank Group is a unique global partnership of five institutions driven by a bold vision to create a world free of poverty on a livable planet. As one of the largest sources of funding and knowledge for developing countries, we help solve the world’s greatest development challenges. When you join the World Bank Group, you become part of a dynamic, diverse organization with 189 member countries and 182 offices worldwide. We work with public and private sector partners, invest in groundbreaking projects, and use data, research, and technology to bring tangible and transformative change around the globe. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org


**Vice\-Presidency Context**


The WBG Budget and Procurement (WBP) is organized into five Departments: WBP Centers of Excellence (WBPCE) with teams supporting the corporate strategic business and budget planning process, providing WBP systems, knowledge, and shared services; WBP IBRD/IDA Regional Units (WBPRU) with teams supporting IBRD/IDA clients in the regions; WBP IFC/MIGA Budget Partners (CSRDR) with teams supporting IFC/MIGA clients in the HQ and the regions; WBP Corporate Units (WBPCU) with teams supporting the Knowledge Bank and corporate units and providing capital budget support; and WBP Corporate Procurement (WBPCP) with teams providing group\-wide procurement services.


**Unit Context**


Steps to continue evolving the management structure of WBPCP with its strategic priorities present the opportunity to recruit for an expanded managerial role in the Department. In line with the WBP global footprint strategy and delivery model, the location of the positions may be Washington D.C., Chennai, or Sofia. In accordance with World Bank Group policy, positions in Country Offices, irrespective of level, are subject to local recruitment. Selections to positions outside of Washington D.C. will be LRS. Business needs and candidate preference will be considered in determining the actual location of each of the positions described below:


Manager, Procurement Operations \& Advisory is responsible for all operational and advisory functions within the Corporate Procurement department. These include the Corporate Procurement Service Desk, Order Management, Vendor Management, governance monitoring, systems support and administration, and regional procurement advisory, amongst others. Manages a global team of 35 staff based in the HQ, Global Business Centers (GBC), and in each of the seven regions of the WBG to support the decentralized footprint of WBG clients.


**Duties and accountabilities:**


Manager, WBPPS has the following three areas of responsibility:


**A)Business Management Responsibilities**


* Manage the teams providing planning, budgeting, and performance reporting services; conducting analytical work and providing advisory services in areas of focus (e.g., operations, investments in technology); and providing other services as needed over time.


* Is an active member of the WBP Leadership Team, participates in cross cutting activities, and from time to time, takes on leadership roles in WBP\-wide activities, such as recruitment and other HR initiatives.


* Provides support and advice to the Vice President and the Director of WBP, Corporate Procurement as requested.


**B)Talent Management Responsibilities**


* Manages the unit staff, including recruitment, evaluation, and career development of staff.


* Provides leadership and support to her/his staff to build sustainable finance skills and capacity to effectively deliver WBP services.


* Manages and oversees the engagement and evaluation of technical consultants within the WBPCP unit, as needed.


**C)Budget Management Responsibilities**


* Effectively and efficiently manages his/her unit’s resources, ensuring its effective formulation and input into budget decisions.


* Advocates and drives cost\-effective delivery of business finance services, promoting transparency, simplicity, standardization, and automation.

**Selection Criteria**


The successful candidate should be recognized for an ability to get things done, strategic thinking and execution leadership, reputation and track record leading large business transformation initiatives, being a problem\-solver, and possessing accomplishments relevant to the WBG’s strategic agenda.


The successful candidate will have an active interest in the activities of the World Bank Group, its mission, products and services in addition to having a strong work ethics and unquestionable integrity, and should possess strong leadership in multicultural environment, and analytical abilities as well as excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills adaptable to all audiences, including Board level.


The candidate should have a minimum of a Master’s degree in relevant field/discipline (e.g., Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Law, etc.), coupled with a minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in procurement, with a strong track record of success in leading and managing complex procurement operations.


The ideal candidate should also possess as many of the following professional and personal characteristics as possible:


* Deep understanding of procurement principles, practices, and regulations, including international procurement standards.


* Strong strategic orientation and ability to manage successfully large work programs and extensively decentralized teams.


* Demonstrated ability to conceptualize complex issues with future focused systematic thinking and frame problems as actionable issues with ability to develop consensus among diverse constituents.


* Proven ability to balance client concerns with wider corporate concerns as well as proven ability to interact effectively with WBG and external counterparts.


* Proven change integrator with ability to effectively lead and implement complex change management initiatives.


* Strong understanding of the workings of the organizational context including the matrix environment with deep functional knowledge of the challenges of resource deployment in Operations.


* Demonstrated effectiveness in collaboration across the Organization including Operations and Corporate functions and proven ability to build common goals and solutions while managing different views.


WBG Managerial Competencies

**WBG Culture Attributes:**


1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  

2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  

3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.


World Bank Group Core Competencies

*The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.*

*We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.*

*Learn more about working at the* *World Bank* *and* *IFC* *including our values and inspiring stories.*

title: Vessel Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.

**Position Description:**



The Vessel Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable and economical operation of assigned vessels. The position applies knowledge of engineering, HR\-management, shipping\-industry regulations, commercial and legal considerations, and guides sea\-staff onboard assigned vessels. The Vessel Manager also takes initiative to continuously improve the performance of assigned ships and strengthens the teamwork between ship and office.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**


* To be familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members either of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines
* Guides, advises, and monitor vessel operations; also assists crew performing vessel maintenance
* Researches technical information related to equipment breakdowns, malfunctions, improvements, upgrades or modifications for the reliable long\-term performance of the vessels
* Prepares for scheduled dry dockings, surveys and repairs on assigned ships, and arranges and manages supply of spares, stores, and services to vessels before scheduled maintenance and breakdown repairs
* Manages vessels in full compliance with local and international rules and regulations; and with Seaspan’s Safety Management System (SMS)
* Analyses ships’ performance and relays this information to the onboard master and chief engineer; ensures compliance with current charter\-party terms of employment and other commercial concerns
* Ensures compliance with all necessary operational certification and survey requirements applicable to assigned vessels
* Visits vessels port; may sail with Seaspan ships to reasonably ascertain that they are operated in a safe, reliable and economical way
* Monitors function and performance during ship visits and initiates effective problem solving of on\-board issues, including technical, quality\-assurance, health and safety, commercial or personnel issues
* Takes ownership of on\-board issues and follows them through to resolution
* Prepares budgets in the required detail for the yearly operation of assigned ships, scheduled dry dockings, surveys, repairs and ad\-hoc modifications and repairs within required timelines
* Monitors expenses of assigned vessels and submits monthly variance reporting and tracks against budget
* Ensures that all reporting employees adhere to company policies and procedures
* Communicates expectations to direct reports; manages performance and provides leadership and support to team members
* Demonstrates commitment to Seaspan’s Maritime Resource Management values
* Performs other duties as required

  


**Requirements:**


* Must have at least one year of experience as a technical superintendent in a company managing handy\-max sized (or larger) vessels engaged in international trading and must have a minimum of one full year in rank as a chief engineer orhave completed three contracts as a chief engineer with Seaspan
* English language skills, both verbal and written, must be effective and suitable for a multi\-cultural working environment
* Strong technical knowledge
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite (including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel)
* Class 1 marine engineer certificate
* Degree in marine engineering or equivalent

  

  

**Additional Desired Qualifications:**


* Experience working with container ships
* Education in mechanical engineering or naval architecture
* Previous experience with new\-builds and dry\-dockings preferred

  


**Job Demands and/or Physical Requirements:**


* Regular international travel is required and may be on short notice
* Must have mobility to conduct vessel inspections
* Will be required to carry a mobile device and check regularly outside of office hours
* Must maintain a home internet connection for work outside of office hours


Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sourcing strategies, building strong talent pipelines, and delivering high\-quality candidates for both niche and volume hiring requirements.



This role requires a proactive sourcing professional with a strong understanding of technology talent markets and the ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Background**

Akshar Yoga Kendraaa, is a 20\+ year old organisation founded by Himalayan Siddhaa Akshar. We are an internationally recognized institution that is officially accredited by the Yoga Certification Board (YCB) under the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India.

title: Manager - HR Operations
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented **HR Operations Executive / Senior Executive** with a minimum of **4 years of experience** in HR operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day HR processes, ensuring compliance with company policies and statutory regulations, maintaining employee records, and delivering a seamless employee lifecycle experience. The role requires strong knowledge of HR operations, payroll coordination, attendance management, HRMS, and statutory compliance.

Key ResponsibilitiesHR Operations

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exit formalities.
* Prepare and issue offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, relieving letters, and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and personnel files in the HRMS.
* Ensure timely completion of employee documentation and compliance requirements.

Attendance \& Leave Management

* Monitor employee attendance, shift schedules, leave records, and regularization requests.
* Coordinate with department heads to resolve attendance\-related issues.
* Maintain accurate leave balances and attendance reports.

Payroll Coordination

* Prepare and validate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leaves, incentives, reimbursements, overtime, and deductions.
* Coordinate with the payroll team to ensure timely and accurate salary processing.
* Handle employee payroll\-related queries and discrepancies.

HRMS Administration

* Manage employee information within the HRMS.
* Ensure data accuracy and timely updates of employee records.
* Generate HR reports, dashboards, and MIS as required by management.

Statutory Compliance

* Support compliance with labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Professional Tax, and Shops \& Establishment regulations.
* Maintain statutory records and documentation for audits and inspections.

description:
**Equity Research Analyst**  
VJX Research \| New Delhi \| Full\-Time \| ₹5–9L per annum \| Open to freshers and experienced

**About VJX Research**  
VJX Research is a New Delhi\-based family office investment firm being built from the ground up. We invest in listed and unlisted equities across Indian markets, with a focus on identifying high\-quality businesses with durable competitive advantages. To start, our primary focus is listed Indian equities\-mid, small, and micro\-cap names\- with unlisted opportunities becoming a larger part of the mandate over time. The firm is in its earliest phase: team, systems, brand, and process are all being built now, with the longer\-term goal of a recognized investment platform with an established research team and eventually a formal structure to manage external capital.

**About the Role**  
This is a foundational role on a very small, early team, where the work you do directly shapes how coverage, process, and research quality get built from scratch. You won't be slotted into an existing system, you'll help create it. As the platform grows, the role grows with it: from broad, hands\-on coverage today toward owning a defined area with real depth and independence over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build thorough, well\-reasoned coverage of listed Indian companies, financial models, a real view on the business beyond the numbers, and management engagement where possible
* Include 1–2 micro\-cap names a month as part of your coverage
* Develop select coverage into research pieces we publish publicly, educational and analytical, not buy or sell recommendations
* Build your own network with company management over time, and help identify and coordinate meetings for the founder
* Stay genuinely engaged with markets broadly\-reading widely and contributing your own ideas and perspective, not just executing assigned coverage
* Present your work on a regular basis, with the emphasis on steady, high\-quality progress over hitting a fixed quota

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree required
* CFA Level 1 (cleared or pursuing) or CA (qualified or pursuing) preferred, though not mandatory for a strong candidate
* Genuine, demonstrated interest in financial markets and investing
* Real intellectual curiosity and the ability to think and write clearly
* Comfortable with close collaboration early on and increasing ownership over time

**What We Offer**

* Salary of ₹5–9L per annum, commensurate with experience and quality
* Direct mentorship from the founder and a senior analyst
* Real ownership of your coverage from day one, with a byline on published research
* A role that grows meaningfully in scope and independence as the firm grows
* A front\-row seat to how an investment research platform is built from scratch

**How to Apply**  
Send your CV and a cover note of no more than three paragraphs to vjainventures@gmail.com. In the first, tell us specifically what appeals to you about this role and what makes you the right person for it. In the second, tell us which AI tools you use regularly and how. In the third, tell us a little about yourself beyond your CV\-your background, where you grew up, what has shaped how you think, and what you are genuinely trying to build in the long run. Generic or template cover letters will not be reviewed.

\*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.\*

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

title: Maintenance Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic **Maintenance Engineer** to join our Service \& Maintenance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the reliable operation and maximum uptime of **Data Logger, RTU, PLC, and SCADA systems** through preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and timely corrective actions.

This role is ideal for fresh graduates or candidates with up to one year of experience who are eager to build a career in industrial automation, instrumentation, and control systems.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform scheduled preventive and predictive maintenance of Data Loggers, RTUs, PLC panels, SCADA systems, HMI workstations, and industrial communication networks.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot system faults, including I/O module failures, communication issues, loop errors, and hardware malfunctions to minimize system downtime.
* Carry out minor PLC programming modifications, logic updates, program backups, and SCADA graphic configuration changes as required.
* Inspect, calibrate, and maintain field instruments such as sensors, transmitters, VFDs, actuators, and other control devices connected to automation systems.
* Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot industrial communication networks, including Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and Ethernet/IP.
* Maintain accurate maintenance records, breakdown reports, calibration logs, change management documentation, and inventory of critical spare parts.
* Coordinate with engineering and customer teams to resolve technical issues efficiently.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards, quality procedures, and maintenance best practices during all service activities.
* Provide on\-site support for preventive maintenance, emergency breakdowns, and system restoration whenever required.

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Fresher or up to 1 year of hands\-on experience in Electronics, PLC, SCADA, or Industrial Automation maintenance.
* Working knowledge of PLC and SCADA platforms such as:
* Schneider Electric
* Siemens
* Basic understanding of industrial instrumentation and control systems.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols is an added advantage.
* Willingness to travel within Mumbai and nearby locations as required.

Key Skills

* PLC \& SCADA Maintenance
* Data Logger \& RTU Systems
* Preventive \& Predictive Maintenance
* Fault Diagnosis \& Troubleshooting
* Industrial Networking (Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP)
* Instrument Calibration
* Technical Documentation
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem\-Solving
* Teamwork \& Communication

* Opportunity to work with advanced industrial automation technologies.
* Hands\-on exposure to PLC, SCADA, RTU, and Data Logger systems.

* Collaborative and technology\-driven work environment.
* Competitive salary and career advancement opportunities.

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

title: Data Engineer (Fresher)
description:
Are you a recent graduate looking to start your career as a Data Engineer, building smart workflows that save time and reduce manual effort?


At TORM, our corporate and technology teams work closely together to drive the business forward through innovation and process automation. By combining strong technical skills with a collaborative mindset, we enable scalable, reliable automation solutions across the organization.


As a Fresher Data Engineer, you'll get hands‑on exposure to building automation workflows and scripts, with some exposure to data pipelines, working alongside experienced engineers to deliver reliable solutions for fleet and shore‑based operations.


**Your Role**


In this role, you'll be part of a high‑performing Data \& AI team, learning to build and support automation workflows and scripts end to end. You'll work closely with senior engineers, get mentorship on best practices, and steadily take ownership of tasks that automate repetitive, manual processes across the business.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and workflows using Python to eliminate repetitive, manual business processes
* Schedule, monitor, and maintain automation jobs, ensuring they run reliably and flagging failures early
* Apply data structures and algorithms (DSA) concepts to write efficient, scalable automation code
* Write and optimize SQL queries to support automation workflows that read from or write to databases
* Debug and troubleshoot issues in automation jobs, escalating and documenting fixes
* Assist with basic data pipeline tasks \- extracting, validating, and loading data \- in support of automation and reporting needs
* Collaborate with the team to test, validate, and deploy automation solutions across Dev/Test/Prod environments
* Maintain clear documentation for scripts, workflows, and processes built


We're looking for a motivated fresher who is curious about automation and scripting, enjoys problem‑solving, and is eager to learn in a collaborative, technology‑driven environment.


**To do well in this role, you bring:**


* 0–1 year of experience
* Strong foundation in Python programming
* Good working knowledge of SQL and relational databases
* Solid understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) and problem‑solving ability
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong analytical and logical thinking, with a willingness to learn new tools and technologies
* Good communication and collaboration skills
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken


**Good to Have**


* Exposure to Databricks or other cloud data platforms
* Awareness of Generative AI concepts, such as LLMs and prompt engineering
* Familiarity with Azure or other cloud environments
* Any personal or academic projects involving automation, scripting, or data pipelines


**What We Offer**


At TORM, we are committed to people, communities, and the environment. We offer a competitive salary, along with a bonus scheme, pension, and flexible work hours to help you maintain a healthy balance between your personal and professional life. We know that life can be unpredictable, which is why we provide the support you need to manage personal commitments, whether it’s caring for family or taking time for yourself.


We believe development happens continuously, which is why you'll have access to learning opportunities, mentorship from experienced engineers, and the chance to build your skills in data engineering, automation, Databricks, and GenAI from the ground up and also a variety of local initiatives here, e.g., Fun club, Torm Family Day, Festival celebrations, CSR programs that help you connect, grow, and thrive.


At TORM, diversity and inclusion are integral to our performance. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to share their unique perspectives and join us in building a diverse and inclusive future for the shipping industry.


**How to Apply**


Interested in joining the team? Submit your application via www.torm.com/careers by 26 July 2026\.


We look forward to hearing from you!


Our people are our real assets – and we are more than 3,500 colleagues across the globe working together to supply our customers with the energy products they need. Safely, efficiently, and reliably. We believe in ensuring the best possible working environment for everyone in TORM – both at sea and in our offices. We believe in our people with their diverse backgrounds and value their unique skills and contribution to the organization. By working together in a professional, international and informal atmosphere, we can bring out the best in everyone and deliver outstanding results.  

  

TORM is a world\-leading specialist carrier of energy and clean petroleum products, listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and New York. We have a unique business model where we own and operate our fleet of more than 85 vessels and integrate all key shipping competencies in\-house.

  

  

  

**Application due:**
7/26/2026  

**Location:**  

Mumbai, India  


**Homepage:**  

www.torm.com/careers

title: DVA Modeler (Dimensional Variation Analysis Engineer)
description:
**About the Role**  
We are looking for a DVA Modeler to create, maintain, and validate Dimensional Variation Analysis (DVA) models that simulate assembly processes, tolerances, and CAD data to predict dimensional variation and product quality. This role supports automotive OEM programs and works closely with GDME/DCD engineering teams on appearance, functional, and supplier\-related DVA studies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create, maintain, and validate DVA models using CAD data, locating strategies, input tolerances, and design specifications
* Perform Appearance DVA assessments for exterior and interior components per Ford DCD standards (FDJ to OKTB) and prepare summary reports
* Execute Functional DVA studies for UN/UP functional requirements and prepare technical memo reports
* Conduct What\-If DVA studies covering attachment, packaging, alignment, and TVM actions across vehicle systems (powertrain, exterior, interior, exhaust, battery, engine, chassis)
* Perform Supplier End Item GD\&T DVA studies, develop supplier assembly DVA models, and prepare evidence books
* Validate simulation results, troubleshoot model discrepancies, and incorporate feedback from GDME/DCD engineers
* Support post\-FDJ to OKTB DVA deliverables (DVA X to DVA 3\) with on\-time delivery and zero quality defects

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Experience level: Fresher (1–2 yrs) / Junior (2\+ yrs) / Senior (7\+ yrs) — specify per opening
* Basic knowledge of CAD tools (CATIA, NX) and Dimensional Variation Analysis (DVA) concepts
* Understanding of GD\&T, Statistical Process Control (SPC), automotive engineering principles, and suspension systems
* Hands\-on experience with Vis VSA (Vis Mockup), Teamcenter/Active Workspace, and MS Office
* GD\&T certification preferred (added advantage)

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.

description:
We are looking for a **WordPress Website Executive** to join our team. This role involves creating, customizing, and maintaining WordPress websites using premium ready\-made themes and drag\-and\-drop page builders.

**This is NOT a software development or programming role.** We primarily use **WordPress Themes** to build websites across various industries. The role focuses on website setup, theme customization, content updates, plugin configuration, and basic website management. No custom coding or website development experience is required.

Freshers with practical WordPress knowledge and candidates with 6 months to 2 years of experience are encouraged to apply.

* Configure menus, forms, sliders, galleries, widgets, and other website elements.
* Install, update, and manage WordPress plugins.
* Perform regular website updates and maintenance.
* Ensure websites are mobile\-friendly and responsive.
* Perform basic on\-page SEO (page titles, meta descriptions, image ALT tags, URL structure).
* Test websites before delivery and resolve minor issues.
* Coordinate with the design, content, and digital marketing teams.
* Make revisions based on client feedback.
* Manage multiple client websites simultaneously.
* Assist with website backup and restoration when required.

Required Skills

* Basic experience with WordPress website setup and management.
* Familiarity with the WordPress Dashboard.
* Ability to install and configure WordPress themes and plugins.
* Experience using page builders such as Themify, Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, or similar.
* Basic understanding of website hosting, domains, SSL, and cPanel.
* Basic knowledge of MySQL databases (such as importing/exporting databases using phpMyAdmin).
* Basic understanding of FTP or File Manager.
* Basic knowledge of website backups and restoration.
* Good understanding of responsive website layouts.
* Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
* Good attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to follow project instructions and meet deadlines.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

Skills NOT Required

You **do not need** experience in:

* PHP development
* Custom WordPress theme development
* Plugin development
* Advanced HTML/CSS programming
* Advanced JavaScript
* Laravel, React, Node.js, or similar programming frameworks
* Advanced database programming
* Git or version control systems

Preferred Skills

* Experience working with Themify themes or similar page builders.
* Basic Canva or Photoshop knowledge for image resizing and editing.
* Familiarity with contact forms and lead generation forms.
* Experience uploading blogs, products, and website content.
* Basic understanding of Google Analytics or Search Console is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT for content formatting and website content assistance.

Education

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Diploma or certification in Web Design, Computer Applications, or IT is an added advantage.
* Practical WordPress knowledge is more important than formal qualifications.

Benefits

* Flexible work environment.
* Hands\-on training with premium WordPress themes.
* Opportunity to work on websites across multiple industries.
* Career growth in Website Management and Digital Marketing.
* Exposure to SEO and website optimization techniques.

Important Note

This role is ideal for candidates interested in **WordPress website management and theme customization**. We use **premium WordPress themes** and drag\-and\-drop page builders to create websites. **No custom coding or software development is required.**

Established in 1910, Hari Chand Anand (HCA) is one of India's largest and most established sales, service, and distribution companies for industrial sewing machines, garment automation equipment, and textile machinery. HCA serves garment manufacturers, leather and upholstery units, home textile producers, and embroidery/quilting businesses across India.

**Role Summary**

The Sales Executive will be responsible for driving revenue growth for HCA's Kolkata branch by identifying, developing, and managing customer relationships across the garment manufacturing, textile, and industrial sewing machinery segments. The role requires a proactive, target\-driven individual who can combine technical product knowledge with strong relationship management to grow HCA's market share in the East India region.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales \& Business Development**

● Identify and generate new business leads within garment manufacturing units, textile mills, leather/upholstery producers, and allied industries in and around Kolkata and the broader East India region.

● Conduct regular field visits to existing and prospective customers to understand their machinery requirements and recommend suitable HCA/DUKE products or partner brands (Highlead, Kansai Special, Merrow, etc.).

● Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets assigned by management.

● Prepare and deliver quotations, proposals, and product demonstrations to prospective clients.

**Account Management**

● Maintain and strengthen relationships with existing customers to ensure repeat business and long\-term loyalty.

● Follow up on after\-sales requirements including machine servicing, spare parts orders, and warranty support in coordination with the service team.

● Track customer feedback and machine performance issues, escalating to technical/service teams where needed.

**Market Intelligence \& Reporting**

● Monitor competitor activity, pricing trends, and new product developments in the industrial sewing machinery and textile automation space.

● Maintain accurate records of sales calls, customer interactions, and pipeline status using CRM/reporting tools or formats prescribed by the company.

● Submit regular sales reports, forecasts, and market feedback to the Branch/Regional Manager.

**Coordination**

● Liaise with the internal service, spares, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery, installation, and commissioning of machines at customer sites.

● Coordinate with the accounts team for invoicing, payment collection, and credit control as per company policy.

● Represent HCA at trade fairs, exhibitions, and industry events as required.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Education**

● Graduate in any discipline; a degree/diploma in Textile Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or Business Administration is an added advantage.

**Experience**

● 1–5 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in industrial machinery, textile/garment equipment, capital goods, or allied technical products.

● Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to learn technical products may also be considered for junior positions.

**Skills \& Competencies**

● Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English, Hindi, and Bengali.

● Ability to understand and explain technical product features to non\-technical buyers.

● Self\-motivated with a target\-oriented approach and strong negotiation skills.

● Willingness to travel extensively within Kolkata and surrounding industrial clusters.

● Basic computer proficiency (MS Office, email, CRM tools).

● Valid driving license preferred (two\-wheeler/four\-wheeler).

**What HCA Offers**

● Opportunity to work with India's oldest and most established name in industrial sewing machinery.

● Exposure to a wide portfolio of global brands and cutting\-edge garment automation technology.

● Structured career growth path within a nationwide sales organization.

● Competitive fixed salary plus performance\-based incentives.

Abacus HVAC Solutions is a leading authorized channel partner for top\-tier air conditioning systems, including Carrier and Toshiba. We specialize in providing complete commercial, industrial, and residential HVAC solutions, encompassing VRF/VRV systems, ductable split units, chillers, and centralized air\-conditioning layout execution across various key projects.

* **Site Support:** Coordinate with site engineers to ensure drawing layouts match real\-world installation conditions.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Diploma or ITI in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Drafting, or Draftsmanship (B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering welcome).

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Graphic Designer to create visually appealing designs that effectively communicate our brand message. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for aesthetics, excellent design skills, and the ability to work on multiple projects while meeting deadlines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create engaging graphics for digital and print media, including social media posts, brochures, flyers, banners, posters, and advertisements.
* Develop creative concepts, layouts, and visual designs aligned with brand guidelines.
* Design marketing materials for campaigns, promotions, and events.
* Edit and enhance images, illustrations, and other visual content.
* Collaborate with the marketing, content, and product teams to deliver high\-quality creative assets.
* Prepare final artwork for printing and digital publishing.
* Stay updated with the latest design trends, tools, and technologies.
* Manage multiple projects and deliver designs within deadlines.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Graphic Designer or in a similar role.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative design work.

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
* Knowledge of Canva, Figma, CorelDRAW, or other design tools is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and branding.
* Basic knowledge of video editing and motion graphics is a plus.
* Excellent creativity, communication, and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in digital marketing or social media design.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design principles.
* Knowledge of HTML/CSS is an added advantage.

**Employment Type**

* Full\-time

**Experience**

* 1–3 years (Freshers with a strong portfolio may also apply.)

**Location**

* Gurgaon

**Salary**

* As per industry standards and experience.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible work environment
* Paid leave and holidays

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

title: Content Creator
description:
**Job Summary**

We are hiring an energetic Content Creator to tell the SMEC story across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn. You will script, shoot, and appear in reels, plan content calendars, and turn student success stories and tech topics into engaging content that drives course enquiries. Whether you are a fresher who already creates content or a creator with up to 2 years of experience, if you are comfortable in front of the camera and understand what the Kerala student audience watches, we want to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, script, shoot, and edit reels, shorts, and videos for Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook
* Anchor / appear on camera for course promos, campus tours, student testimonials, and trending\-format videos
* Build and manage a monthly content calendar aligned with course launches, admissions, and campaigns
* Write engaging captions, hooks, and scripts in English and Malayalam (Manglish) for a young student audience
* Cover live events — seminars, workshops, placement drives, and tech fests — and turn them into content
* Interview students, trainers, and placed candidates to create success\-story content
* Track content performance (views, engagement, follower growth) and double down on what works
* Stay on top of social media trends, trending audio, and formats, and adapt them to our brand
* Coordinate with the graphic designer and digital marketing team for creatives and campaign content

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; Media, Communications, or Journalism background is a plus
* 0–2 years of experience in content creation, social media, or video production (personal pages/freelance work counts)
* Confidence in front of the camera with clear, engaging delivery in Malayalam and English
* Hands\-on video shooting and editing skills using mobile or tools like CapCut / Premiere Pro / VN
* Strong scriptwriting and storytelling ability tailored to Instagram reels and YouTube shorts
* Good understanding of what works on Instagram and YouTube for the Kerala audience
* A portfolio of created content — reels, videos, or social media pages (mandatory; personal accounts accepted)
* Familiarity with AI content tools (ChatGPT, caption/script generators) is a plus

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with growth opportunities
* A platform to build your personal brand while building ours
* Creative freedom to experiment with formats, trends, and ideas
* Exposure to the fast\-growing ed\-tech and IT training industry
* Learning access to our in\-house courses and Gen AI tools

**About Us**

SMEC Technologies is Kerala's leading IT training academy, backed by over 25 years of parent\-company experience in engineering and industrial solutions. With centres in Kochi, Calicut, and Trivandrum, we train students in Full Stack Development, Data Science, AI \& ML, Software Testing, and UI/UX Design — and connect with thousands of aspirants every month through our social media, videos, and campaigns.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
