If you're excited about that combination and ready to build learning programs that scale operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Production Support Systems Engineer (Night Shift) maintains the stability and availability of production systems during overnight hours (10:00 PM – 6:00 AM). You'll serve as the primary technical point of contact for incidents, monitoring alerts, and escalations—ensuring issues are triaged, resolved, or escalated with minimal business impact. Working across our AWS\-hosted Python/Django/FastAPI backend and React JS frontend, you'll manage incidents end\-to\-end via JIRA Service Management and monitor system health through Sentry and CloudWatch. This role includes night differential pay and requires on\-call availability for critical escalations outside shift hours.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Create, update, and resolve JIRA Service Management tickets with full incident documentation

* Identify and escalate PostgreSQL query performance issues and connection pool exhaustion
* Distinguish frontend (React JS) issues from backend API failures using Sentry error traces
* Manage and respond to CloudWatch alarms covering CPU, memory, error rates, and 5xx responses
* Perform environment health checks at shift start and end; validate batch job completion
* Monitor RDS metrics and identify slow query patterns; escalate with supporting evidence
* Execute scheduled overnight maintenance including deployments, database migrations, and config changes
* Validate nightly backup and data replication processes; escalate failures promptly
* Document incident root cause, resolution steps, and preventive notes in JIRA
* Contribute to and maintain runbooks and SOPs in the team knowledge base
* Support planned change windows by monitoring post\-deployment behavior and coordinating rollbacks via Git

****Key requirements:****
 We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
   

  

* 2–4 years of experience in Production Support, NOC, DevOps, or SRE roles

About the role
 



 We design and build connected hardware devices; that run in thousands of homes and gated communities. This role sits right at the boundary of hardware and firmware: you'll help take boards from schematic to bring\-up to shipping firmware, working alongside senior engineers, ODM/vendor partners, and the cloud and mobile teams.
 



 It's a hands\-on role for someone early in their career who's genuinely excited about embedded systems; equally happy with a soldering iron and a debugger.
 



 What you'll do
 


* Design and lay out PCBs; schematic capture, component selection, multi\-layer layout, and BOM prep under the guidance of senior engineers

 What we're looking for
 


* BE/BTech in Electronics, Electrical, ECE, or a related field

* Comfortable reading schematics and datasheets
* Familiarity with common interfaces (UART, I2C, SPI, GPIO)

 Nice to have (not required)
 


* Exposure to ESP32 / STM32, an RTOS (e.g. FreeRTOS), or embedded Linux
* Experience with version control (Git)
* Familiarity with wireless protocols (BLE, Wi\-Fi) or IoT cloud connectivity (MQTT)

* Basic Python for scripting and bench/test automation



 Why join
 


* Own real hardware that ships to real users
* Learn the full product lifecycle concept, schematic, layout, firmware, manufacturing directly from senior engineers
* Join a small, high\-ownership team where your work has visible impact

title: EMBEDDED FIRMWARE ENGINEER
description:
**About the Role** 


 We are building a next\-generation field\-use IoT instrumentation product that integrates multiple measurement modalities, a smart touch display, cloud connectivity, and over\-the\-air firmware management. You will be a core embedded engineer responsible for developing, optimising, and maintaining firmware across a complex, multi\-featured embedded system.
 





 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will own features end\-to\-end — from low\-level peripheral drivers and sensor interfaces to display UI logic, cloud data pipelines, and battery management — working closely with the product and hardware teams.
 




  




**What You Will Do** 
* Develop and maintain production\-grade firmware for a resource\-constrained embedded SoC running FreeRTOS
* Implement and integrate communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, ADC) for sensor interfaces and peripheral devices
* Build and maintain multi\-screen touch display UI logic, handling state machines, screen transitions, and event\-driven interactions
* Develop reliable IoT data pipelines including MQTT over Wi\-Fi, with AWS cloud integration
* Design and implement robust OTA (Over\-the\-Air) firmware update workflows with rollback safety
* Manage NVS\-based persistent storage: calibration data, configuration, session logs, and device state
* Write analog front\-end integration code for electrochemical and optical sensor modalities (pH, conductivity, colorimetry)
* Implement battery management logic: SOC estimation, charge state detection, display integration
* Write clean, modular, well\-documented C code suitable for long\-term team maintenance
* Participate in design reviews, write technical documentation, and support test engineers during hardware validation



  




**Must\-Have Qualifications** 
**Embedded Firmware** 
* 3\+ years of embedded C firmware development in a production environment
* Strong working knowledge of FreeRTOS: tasks, queues, semaphores, timers, event groups
* Experience with the ESP32 ecosystem; ESP\-IDF framework experience is strongly preferred
* Solid understanding of peripheral interfaces: UART (framed protocol with checksums), SPI, I2C, ADC
* Ability to read and work with complex, multi\-module codebases — not just write greenfield code


**IoT \& Connectivity** 
* MQTT protocol: broker connection management, QoS levels, topic design, payload serialisation (JSON)
* Wi\-Fi provisioning and connection lifecycle management on embedded targets
* AWS IoT Core or equivalent cloud platform integration
* OTA firmware update implementation with partition management and fallback handling


**Display \& UI** 
* Experience integrating serial\-protocol smart display modules (UART\-based command/response panels)
* Multi\-screen UI state machine design: screen navigation, touch event handling, data binding to display registers
* Familiarity with industrial or field\-device HMI concepts


**Sensors \& Signal Conditioning** 
* Integration experience with analog sensors: understanding of ADC oversampling, filtering, and calibration workflows
* Familiarity with electrochemical measurement principles (pH, conductivity) at a firmware integration level
* Ability to implement lookup tables, interpolation, and threshold\-based decision logic in firmware


**Engineering Practices** 
* Experience working from detailed written specifications and translating them into clean implementation
* Version control with Git; structured code review and documentation habits
* Debugging skills: JTAG/SWD, serial logging, logic analyser, oscilloscope — comfortable diagnosing both firmware and hardware issues



  




**Good to Have** 
* Experience with DWIN DGUS II display protocol or similar smart display platforms
* BLE 5\.x integration on embedded SoCs (advertising, GATT services, bonding)
* NVS / flash storage schema design for structured persistent data
* SD card file system integration (FAT/exFAT) on embedded targets
* Familiarity with agricultural or environmental sensing instrumentation
* Python scripting for test automation or log parsing

title: Product Manager - LAP
description:
Own a core part of the LAP product end\-to\-end \- from problem, to roadmap, to a shipped and measured outcome. LAP (Loan Against Property) is a secured\-lending product \- larger loans, longer timelines, and real operational, credit, and regulatory complexity. As PM, you'll own a slice of it \- the customer journey from application to disbursal, onboarding and verification, or a brand\-new feature \- and be accountable for its outcome. You'll set the roadmap, write the specs, drive engineering, manage the partners in the flow, and bring leadership clear recommendations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* The roadmap and outcomes for your area — turning business goals into a prioritized, defensible plan.
* Clear product specs and user stories; breaking ambiguous problems into shippable pieces.
* Your own data. Pull and interrogate it yourself (SQL, product analytics tools) to find where customers drop off, size opportunities, and prove impact — without waiting on an analyst.
* Flows that survive the real world — designed hand\-in\-hand with Credit, Sales, Operations, and Compliance.
* The external partners and vendors that sit inside the lending flow — evaluating, negotiating, and managing them (e.g. credit bureau, KYC/video\-verification, digital signing, auto\-debit mandates, banking and valuation partners).
* The voice of the borrower — including the cases where agents or channel partners sit between us and the customer.
* Direct working relationships with senior leadership, bringing them structured, decision\-ready thinking.



  





**What we're looking for (must\-haves)** 



* **1\.5–2 years in lending product** 
 , within a broader product/analytics background. Secured\-lending experience is a strong plus.
* **Tech\-first.** 
 You read technical/API documentation on your own, challenge engineering on how things are built, and reason about trade\-offs \- not just the screens.
* **Data\-fluent.** 
 You can write or read SQL and build a drop\-off funnel yourself.
* **Regulatory instinct.** 
 You understand how lending regulations (KYC norms, video verification, loan\-pricing and fee disclosures, fair lending practices) shape what you can ship — and you design with those guardrails in mind.
* **Strong written structuring.** 
 You turn a messy problem into a clear one\-pager.
* **High ownership, street\-smart, a genuine go\-getter.** 
 Comfortable in ambiguity, biased to ship, and you close loops without being chased.
* **Influence without authority** 
 across Sales, Credit, and Operations.



  





**About Kissht:** 




 Kissht is a Great Place to Work® certified consumer\-first credit app transforming the landscape of
 



 consumer lending through data and machine\-based decisioning. Serving over 15 million customers, including a significant share from Tier\-2 cities and beyond, Kissht offers short\-term and long\-term loans for personal, business, and recurring needs.
 



  





 Founded by IIT and IIM alumni and backed by leading investors such as Endiya Partners, Brunei Investment Authority, and the Singapore Government, Kissht is among India’s fastest growing fintech companies. Join us to be part of a dynamic and innovative organization shaping the future of financial technology.

 who can turn complex fintech and engineering concepts into clear, precise, and engaging documentation. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to make sure our documentation empowers developers, partners, and internal teams to move fast and build confidently.

* Create documentation strategy and establish standards for clarity, structure, and tone across all technical content.

* Proven experience writing API documentation, developer guides, or integration content \- preferably in fintech, SaaS, or API\-led products.
* Excellent command of written English, with strong editing and structuring skills.

 At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control \- helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 Path\-iQ helps pathologists, laboratories, and researchers move from fragmented, traditional workflows to a unified, digital\-first environment powered by artificial intelligence. The platform supports AI\-assisted analysis of histopathology images, cloud\-based case access and collaboration, and scalable, workflow\-driven diagnostics. By enabling faster turnaround times for critical cases, Path\-iQ aims to make cancer diagnosis more rapid, accessible, and consistent regardless of location. The company is building the infrastructure layer for the future of pathology, where digital workflows and AI\-driven insights improve clinical outcomes.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a remote, contract Business Analyst role focused on supporting the design and optimization of digital pathology workflows. The Business Analyst will gather, analyze, and document business requirements from internal stakeholders and external clients, translating them into clear specifications for product and engineering teams. Day\-to\-day work includes mapping current business processes, identifying gaps and improvement opportunities, and proposing data\-driven solutions that enhance efficiency and user experience. The role involves preparing functional documentation, supporting user acceptance testing, and communicating findings and recommendations through reports, presentations, and regular stakeholder updates. The Business Analyst will collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and technical teams to ensure alignment between clinical needs, platform capabilities, and business goals.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop actionable insights.
* Practical experience in business analysis, including requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Ability to analyze and optimize business processes, with experience in workflow design or process improvement methodologies.
* Skill in defining and managing business requirements, translating them into technical or functional specifications.
* Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to present complex information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working in remote, cross\-functional teams and managing priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Familiarity with healthcare, laboratory, or clinical workflows, particularly in pathology or diagnostics, is a plus.
* Proficiency with common business analysis tools (e.g., process mapping tools, requirements management tools, spreadsheets, and presentation software).
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with AI\-driven platforms, cloud\-based solutions, or digital health products is beneficial.

title: Business Analyst, Misleading Claims
job_function: Project Management, Management, and Product Management
description:
**Description**
 Misleading Claims is part of the Regulatory Intelligence Safety and Compliance (RISC) organization. We are on a mission to protect customers from false and deceptive claims on products, enabling trustworthy shopping experiences at Amazon.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to drive the metrics strategy and data infrastructure for Amazon's Misleading Claims program. This role will define, build, and own the key performance metrics that measure program effectiveness in protecting customers from deceptive product claims across our marketplace. The ideal candidate will independently identify underlying data sources, design new metrics frameworks where none exist, and deliver actionable insights that shape program direction. You will partner with Risk Management, Tech, Science, and Ops teams to translate complex enforcement outcomes into measurable business indicators. Strong analytical judgment, deep SQL proficiency, and experience working with trust and safety or compliance programs are essential. This role requires the ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where data definitions and measurement approaches must be built from the ground up.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end metrics framework for the Misleading Claims program, including identifying gaps in existing measurement, creating new metrics, and establishing baselines and targets for program performance
* Independently identify, evaluate, and onboard underlying data sources across enforcement, detection, and seller behavior systems to build a comprehensive data foundation for program analytics
* Design and build dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide real\-time visibility into program health, enforcement accuracy, detection coverage, and seller impact
* Independently collaborate across cross\-functional teams – Risk, Legal, Operations, Science, Tech, and Finance – to align on metric definitions, data requirements, and reporting cadences
* Provide data\-driven and actionable insights to senior stakeholders to influence roadmaps, prioritize enforcement strategies, and measure the effectiveness of ML/AI detection models
* Develop key performance indicators that track progress against business objectives, including detection precision/recall, false positive rates, enforcement turnaround times, and seller remediation outcomes
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on misleading claims trends, abuse patterns, and enforcement outcomes to identify root causes and recommend program improvements
* Build scalable, repeatable analytical processes and self\-service tools that reduce dependency on ad\-hoc analysis and enable the team to make faster, data\-informed decisions


**About The Team**
 Misleading Claims is part of the Regulatory Intelligence Safety and Compliance (RISC) organization, on a mission to protect customers from false and deceptive claims on products, enabling trustworthy shopping experiences at Amazon. As a newly established enforcement program, we're building comprehensive policies, designing enforcement mechanisms, and developing scalable solutions leveraging ML/AI technologies to safeguard customers across our marketplace. Our team collaborates closely with Product Quality, Legal, Tech, Science, and Operations teams to define and execute misleading claims controls at scale. We're establishing success metrics, creating seller education programs, and implementing a risk\-based approach that balances customer protection with seller success. This is an opportunity to shape a critical trust and safety program from the ground up, with direct impact on customer experience and marketplace integrity.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 2\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with Excel
* Experience with SQL


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience partnering with executive\-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues

description:

 At Amazon.com, we strive to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company. To support this vision, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you would like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to work hard, have fun, and make history.
   

  

 We are looking for a talented Business Analyst to join the Trustworthy Shopping Experience Operations Analytics Team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**An Ideal Candidate For This Role**
* Will have relevant experience in data analytics working with large data sets and to extract and transform data using various tools and technologies
* Will transform data into actionable business information, and will make it readily accessible to stakeholders worldwide
* Will use data to support ideas, drive actionable outcomes, and provide unique ways to present data and information in an easy to consume format

* Will be very comfortable juggling competing priorities and handling ambiguity
* Will thrive in an agile and fast\-paced environment on highly visible projects and initiatives

 As a Business Analyst, you will help develop an analytic solution to drive deep dives, provide insights into the health and state of the Operations and measure business impact. description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L \- Listen and be authentic, E \- Energise and inspire, A \- Align across the enterprise, D \- Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship \- our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset \- to Empower, Challenge and Drive \- the operating manual for how we behave.
   

  

 Join Barclays as a Business Analyst, delivering business, customer and operational value in a fast\-paced technology change environment. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

**To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should have experience with:**
* Experience in translating business and operational needs into succinct requirements, and associated analysis and design articulation methods.
* Experience across the full project lifecycle (from inception to closure) with strong knowledge of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Understanding of the payments industry and payment technologies.
* Ability to use effective questioning techniques to identify, analyse and address underlying business needs.
* Strong understanding of risk management, control environments, and policy frameworks.
* Good understanding of Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Experience with delivery workflow and articulation tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Strong MS Office skills, including advanced Excel (formulas, VLOOKUPs, macros), Word and PowerPoint.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**
* Formal training in business analysis and change management (e.g. BCS Business Analysis Diploma, BCS Agile Certification).
* Understanding of data integration concepts, including APIs and data transfer mechanisms.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based applications and platforms.
* Experience within the financial services industry.

title: Associate Consultant IT Due Diligence
description:
**Job Description**
 \#KGS
   

  

 KPMG Global Services (KGS) was set up in India in 2008\. It is a strategic global delivery organization, which works with more than 50 KPMG member firms to provide a progressive, scalable and customized approach to business requirements
   

  

 The KGS journey has been one of consistent growth, with a current employee count of nearly 10,000 operating from four locations in India — Bengaluru, Gurugram, Kochi and Pune, providing a range of Advisory and Tax\-related services to member firms within the KPMG network.
   

  

 As part of KPMG in India, we were ranked among the top companies to work for in the country for four years in a row by LinkedIn, and recognized as one of the top three employers in the region for women, as well as for policies on Inclusion \& Diversity by ASSOCHAM (The Associated Chambers of Commerce \& Industry of India).
   

  

**Team Overview**
 The position in discussion is with Integration \& Separation (I\&S), Technology in M\&A within the Deal Advisory group at KPMG Global Services (KGS), which is KPMG’s global delivery center and an integral part of the firm’s strategy to enhance innovation, build scalability, and improve profitability globally.
   

  

* KGS DA\&S has been providing solutions to KPMG member firms globally. By leveraging insights and applying best practices, the team helps create customized approaches to M\&A transactions. The team’s capabilities include Corporate Finance, Transaction Services, Strategy, Business Modelling, Accounting Advisory Services, Deal Advisory Research and Benchmarking.
* KPMG’s Integration \& Separation team (ISA) advises clients on executing the operational integrations of acquisitions or joint ventures, and separations of businesses, in the case of divestitures or sale. I\&S does this by taking an enterprise‑wide view of M\&A deals, across all the functions, to deliver value to our clients. In addition, team is also involved in pre\-deal Due Diligence on specific areas of business.
* The Technology in M\&A team is involved in pre\-deal and post\-deal execution work related to technology strategy, with focus on identifying potential risks, synergies and optimization of the IT function. The team works on a wide range of technology due diligence and operational integration activities which includes TSA development, Integration Readiness, Day 1 preparation and supporting the implementation of such plans.


**Responsibilities**
 We are recruiting for Associate Consultant in the Technology M\&A team.
   

  

 In this role, you will work on projects working closely alongside senior members of the team, who will provide guidance and insight into the deal environment, enabling you to build your transactions knowledge and further develop your technology skills base.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

title: Functional Tester
description:
**Your potential, unleashed.** 




  





 India’s impact on the global economy has increased at an exponential rate and Deloitte presents an opportunity to unleash and realise your potential amongst cutting edge leaders, and organisations shaping the future of the region, and indeed, the world beyond.
 



  





 At Deloitte, your whole self to work, every day. Combine that with our drive to propel with purpose and you have the perfect playground to collaborate, innovate, grow, and make an impact that matters.
 



  





**The team** 




 The Digital Excellence Centre is responsible for building products and platforms for Deloitte India that focuses on providing extraordinary customer experience by putting design thinking with trailblazing technology in the center of what they do. The diverse team consists of subject matter experts, technology specialists, quality engineers, user experience researchers \& designers, data scientists and product managers
 



  





**Your work profile** 




  





 As a
 **Sr. Executive**
 in our
 **DEC** 
 Team you’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations: \-
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



1. Understand the application under test, plan, author and execute test cases.
2. Conduct exploratory testing and provide in depth analysis on the same
3. Understand what test cases can be automated and automate the same.
4. Find defects, log, and track them.



  





**As a prospective candidate, you should possess:** 



1. Deep understanding of software testing, its main concepts, and processes: the whole bug life cycle; different testing levels, methods, and types; test estimation techniques.
2. Having 2\-4 years of experience in Test automation.
3. Ability to work in agile environment.
4. Critical thinking and analytical skills to examine bug reports and prioritize necessary tests, what information to include in the daily status reports, prioritize and estimate task execution.
5. Good communication and teamwork skills to interact with project team members, clients, and stakeholders.
6. Work closely with dev team \- from reproducing the reported issue and emphasizing the fix for critical bugs to understanding how the bug has been fixed.
7. Programming skills are always a plus including coding, basic SQL knowledge to extract data for tests, XML, general web development skills, and web services



  





**Desired qualifications** 



* Graduation
* Graduation from Eng. Background Preferred



  





**Location and way of working** 



* Base location: Bangalore
* This profile does not involve extensive travel for work.
* Hybrid is our default way of working. Each domain has customised the hybrid approach to their unique needs.



  





**Your role as a Sr. Executive** 




  





 We expect our people to embrace and live our purpose by challenging themselves to identify issues that are most important for our clients, our people, and for society.
 



  





 In addition to living our purpose, Senior Executive across our organization must strive to be:
 



  




* Inspiring \- Leading with integrity to build inclusion and motivation
* Committed to creating purpose \- Creating a sense of vision and purpose
* Agile \- Achieving high\-quality results through collaboration and Team unity
* Skilled at building diverse capability \- Developing diverse capabilities for the future
* Persuasive / Influencing \- Persuading and influencing stakeholders
* Collaborating \- Partnering to build new solutions
* Delivering value \- Showing commercial acumen
* Committed to expanding business \- Leveraging new business opportunities
* Analytical Acumen \- Leveraging data to recommend impactful approach and solutions through the power of analysis and visualization
* Effective communication – Must be well abled to have well\-structured and well\-articulated conversations to achieve win\-win possibilities
* Engagement Management / Delivery Excellence \- Effectively managing engagement(s) to ensure timely and proactive execution as well as course correction for



 the success of engagement(s)
 


* Managing change \- Responding to changing environment with resilience
* Managing Quality \& Risk \- Delivering high quality results and mitigating risks with utmost integrity and precision
* Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving \- Applying strategic mindset to solve business issues and complex problems
* Tech Savvy \- Leveraging ethical technology practices to deliver high impact for clients and for Deloitte
* Empathetic leadership and inclusivity \- creating a safe and thriving environment where everyone's valued for who they are, use empathy to understand others to adapt our behaviours and attitudes to become more inclusive.



  





**How you’ll grow** 




  





***Connect for impact***




  





 Our exceptional team of professionals across the globe are solving some of the world’s most complex business problems, as well as directly supporting our communities, the planet, and each other. Know more in our Global Impact Report and our India Impact Report.
 



  





***Empower to lead***




  





 You can be a leader irrespective of your career level. Our colleagues are characterised by their ability to inspire, support, and provide opportunities for people to deliver their best and grow both as professionals and human beings. Know more about Deloitte and our One Young World partnership.
 



  





***Inclusion for all***




  





 At Deloitte, people are valued and respected for who they are and are trusted to add value to their clients, teams and communities in a way that reflects their own unique capabilities. Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive.
 

 At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.
 



  





***Drive your career***




  





 At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. We recognise there is no one size fits all career path, and global, cross\-business mobility and up / re\-skilling are all within the range of possibilities to shape a unique and fulfilling career. Know more about Life at Deloitte.
 



  





**Everyone’s welcome… entrust your happiness to us** 




  





 Our workspaces and initiatives are geared towards your 360\-degree happiness. This includes specific needs you may have in terms of accessibility, flexibility, safety and security, and caregiving. Here’s a glimpse of things that are in store for you.
 



  





**Interview tips** 




  





 We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared, confident and comfortable. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research, know some background about the organisation and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.


**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
   

  

 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

* Write product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

description:
**Job Title: Full Stack Developer** 




**Location: Kochi, India** 




**Permanent – Full time** 




  





**About Us** 




 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400 employees and 70,000 customers across 100 countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.
 



  





 Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.
 



  





 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisition s, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.
 



  





**Build Your Career with Cyncly in Kochi** 




  





 Kochi is Cyncly’s newest hub, opening doors to exciting career opportunities across diverse functions. Here, you’ll collaborate with global experts, engage in innovative projects, and grow in a culture that values innovation, flexibility, and continuous learning. With access to top mentors, excellent learning resources, and a flexible and autonomous working environment, you’ll have everything you need to thrive.
 



  





 Make it amazing—take your career to the next level with Cyncly in Kochi!
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking exceptional graduate developers to join our engineering team in Kochi, India. In this role, you will help maintain and add features to a world\-leading graphical application, consisting of a high\-performance Delphi back\-end and modern React, React\-Native and Delphi front\-ends.
 



  





 Unlike typical entry\-level jobs, you will have the opportunity to work on a wide range of interesting projects, from intuitive GUIs to complex mathematical algorithms, stunning 3D drawings and advanced React web applications. You will be fully immersed in, and gain experience across, all aspects of the software development lifecycle.

title: Freelance Frontend Developer (Landing Pages & Websites)
description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled F
 **rontend Developers (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React/Next.js)** 
 to join the Tendem project (https://tendem.ai/) and build high\-quality landing pages and multi\-page websites within our hybrid AI \+ human environment. In this role, as an AI Pilot \- that's how we refer to this position at Mindrift \- you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide frontend craftsmanship, design sensibility, and quality control to ensure pixel\-perfect, conversion\-ready websites that match real client briefs. This part\-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands\-on experience in landing page production, multi\-page website development, and modern frontend frameworks.
   

  

**What We Do**
 The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real\-world expertise from across the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Frontend Developer, you'll design, build, and refine landing pages, waitlist pages, promo pages, and small multi\-page sites (portfolios, restaurant sites, small business sites, simple online stores), turning client briefs into responsive, performant, polished web experiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build landing pages, waitlist pages, and promo pages with clear hero sections, CTAs, and conversion\-focused layouts
* Build small multi\-page websites (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.) that follow client requirements and basic information architecture
* Implement responsive, mobile\-first layouts that work cleanly across devices and browsers
* Integrate forms, email capture, basic analytics, and simple CMS or headless content sources
* Apply on\-page SEO basics (semantic HTML, meta tags, performance, accessibility) so pages are ready to rank and run ads against
* Evaluate AI\-generated frontend output and refine markup, styling, structure, and copy placement to production quality
* Troubleshoot layout, performance, and cross\-browser issues independently


**Requirements And Benefits**
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in frontend development, landing page production, or website development (required)
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Design, or related fields is a plus
* Candidates should have a strong foundation in modern frontend development, responsive web design, and building high\-quality landing pages and small websites. We are looking for specialists who can create polished, conversion\-focused user experiences, work confidently with modern frontend frameworks, and refine AI\-assisted output into production\-ready interfaces. A strong visual eye, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential
* Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including responsive design, Flexbox, and Grid
* Hands\-on experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro, or similar)
* Experience with utility\-first CSS (Tailwind) or modern component libraries
* Ability to translate Figma designs or written briefs into clean, maintainable code
* Familiarity with form handling, email capture services, and basic analytics setup (GA4, Plausible, or similar)
* Working knowledge of on\-page SEO, accessibility (WCAG basics), and Core Web Vitals
* Comfortable working with simple CMSs or headless content (Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Contentful, or similar) is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and visual taste — pages should look intentional, not generic
* Self\-directed work ethic with the ability to deliver complete pages with minimal supervision
* Portfolio of shipped landing pages and/or small websites (required)
* English proficiency: Upper\-intermediate (B2\) or above (required)


**Project time expectations**
 For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10\-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.
   

  

**Compensation**
 On this project, contributors can earn up to
 **$35 per hour equivalent** 
 , depending on their level and pace of contribution.
   

  

 Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
   

  

**Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?**
* Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection
* Gain hands\-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field
* Participate in performance\-based bonus programs that reward high\-quality work and consistent delivery

title: Software Engineer (Unity)
description:
Scopely is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Royal Lounge Casino team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis!
   

  

 At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day \- whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
   

  

 With 30M\+ downloads, Royal Lounge Casino is home to slots, bingo, cards, and more! Team members are distributed across the globe with hubs in Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Barcelona, among others
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the implementation of game functionality as per design documents and specifications. Additionally, you will provide inputs on design and architecture keeping in the mind the best practices for development.
   

  

* You will communicate with all the team members to establish a pipeline and integrate art assets, taking into account the game roadmap.
* You will work closely with the game designers and artists to enable the designers and artists to express their creativity within the game.
* You will assist your project lead by providing regular feedback on implementation issues and possible improvements to game design.
* You will actively suggest and implement the best solutions in the development process and in the game systems. Also, you will address bugs and other technical issues identified for subsequent release.
* You will be responsible for technical documentation.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 2\+ Year’s experience with Mobile/Unity3D platform and ecosystem.
* Strong at solving logical problems \& C\# programming.
* Good knowledge of computer science fundamentals \& concepts.
* A natural flair for writing well\-structured, optimal, and maintainable quality code.
* Basic understanding of programming best practices.
* Good communication skills.
* Familiarity with build systems.
* Knowledge of using version control systems like Git.
* Experience using debugging and profiling tools.
* Familiar with mobile native languages like objective\-c, Java, C\+\+, etc.
* Passionate about games, especially in playing mobile games.
* Experience or hands\-on use of AI tools is a plus.


 At Scopely, we create games for everyone \- and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us \& embrace the adventure!
   

  

**About Scopely**
 Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all\-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live\-operates one of the most diversified and award\-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
   

  

 Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world\-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet\-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the \#1 mobile games company in the U.S. and \#2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
   

  

 Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.
   

  

 Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.
   

  

 Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

 Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. title: Game Designer I
description:
**Description \& Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

**Game Designer I**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, Telangana, India
   

  

**About EA**
 We’re EA \- the world’s largest video game publisher. You’re probably familiar with many of our titles \-
 **Madden, FIFA, The Sims, Need for Speed, Dead Space, Battlefield, and Star Wars** 
 , to name a few. What you might not know is how deeply we are committed to creating games for every platform \- from social to mobile to console \- providing players access anytime, anywhere.
   

  

 For you, that means
 **more opportunities to unleash your creativity** 
 , be inspired by passionate teams, and build a meaningful career in any direction you choose.
   

  

 As EA’s first label dedicated to purely digital games,
 **EA Mobile** 
 delivers seamless, high\-quality entertainment across mobile, social, and online platforms. With more than
 **one billion players worldwide** 
 , we create accessible, engaging experiences for all types of gamers.
   

  

 The
 **Hyderabad studio** 
 is one of EA Mobile’s largest development centers, with 700\+ mobile gaming experts across design, engineering, testing, production, and live services. Our Game Development team is focused on building and running live services for some of EA’s top mobile titles.
   

  

 Our vision is to be
 **EA Mobile’s center of excellence for Live Services** 
 and expand EA’s footprint in the casual gaming market.
   

  

**Our Core Values**
* Tenacity – Hunger to prove yourself and push boundaries
* Ownership – Commitment to delivering results
* Passion – Deep love for the craft of making games
* Collaboration – Belief that great things are built together
* Alchemy – Bringing creativity and magic to everything you do


 Role Overview
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Game Designer I** 
 to help craft engaging features, live events, and economy experiences for
 **Golf Clash** 
 . In this role, you will own small to mid\-sized assignments, contribute to live\-service feature development, and help improve the player journey through clear design thinking, strong documentation, tuning, and cross\-discipline collaboration.
   

  

 You will work closely with leads and partner teams to design and iterate on systems such as live events, progression, rewards, economy flows, and player\-facing feature improvements. You will play the game regularly, understand how players engage with Golf Clash, and use feedback, data, and competitive insights to create accessible, rewarding, and friction\-light experiences.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Own and deliver small to mid\-sized features, content, live ops elements, and tuning tasks for Golf Clash.
* Support the design of self\-contained live events, including event rules, reward structures, progression, pacing, and player\-facing requirements.
* Contribute to systems and economy design work across areas such as coin wagering, Club Cards, rewards, progression, and new\-to\-mid game player experience.
* Build clear design documentation with goals, requirements, dependencies, edge cases, tuning values, and implementation notes.
* Partner with leads to ensure feature goals, success criteria, player motivations, and technical constraints are clearly understood.
* Use internal tools and GameData structures to implement, tune, validate, and iterate on features and content.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, analytics, UX, art, production, and QA/QV teams throughout development.
* Support playtests, UX reviews, feedback loops, and tuning passes to improve feature quality before and after launch.
* Review telemetry, player feedback, and qualitative playtest results to identify issues and propose practical improvements.
* Research comparable mobile F2P and casual games, including event structures, leaderboards, matchmaking flows, reward loops, and surfacing patterns.
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, unclear requirements, and player experience concerns, escalating them with recommended next steps.
* Play Golf Clash regularly to build deep familiarity with its systems, meta, economy, player journey, and live\-service expectations.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 3\+ years of game design experience.
* Experience working on mobile F2P games from concept through live service.
* Proficiency in at least one core design domain, with developing skills across systems, economy, content, features, or live ops.
* Ability to prototype, tune, and iterate features or content to meet design goals, quality standards, and KPIs.
* Familiarity with Game Data systems, internal tools, design documentation, and design\-to\-engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of player motivations, progression, pacing, game balance, and live\-service content expectations.
* Ability to analyze player experience, identify friction points, and propose practical design solutions.
* Comfort working with metrics, telemetry, playtest feedback, and qualitative insights to guide iteration.
* Strong communication, documentation, prioritization, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to own work independently while partnering with leads for alignment, feedback, and escalation.
* Curiosity for competitive research and a willingness to learn from modern mobile, casual, and live\-service games.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience working on systems or economy design for mobile F2P games.
* Experience designing live events, reward loops, leaderboards, progression systems, or matchmaking\-adjacent systems.
* Experience with sports, skill\-based PvP, or competitive multiplayer games.
* Familiarity with Unity, Perforce, scripting, XML, or proprietary game data tools.
* Interest in golf, mobile sports games, competitive casual games, and long\-running live services.


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

***Professional people finder. Part\-time detective. Full\-time chaos coordinator.***

At **Unosecur**, we don't just hire people—we find the humans who make Mondays slightly less painful.

**One Last Thing**If your friends always ask you to "talk to people" because you're the social one. **Job Title: HR \& Admin Intern** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Internship
 



  





**About Us** 




 AuthenticOne is a CERT\-In empaneled and CREST Accredited Cybersecurity solutions and services company with expertise in consulting, advisory, and risk management. AuthenticOne specialises in Comprehensive Compliance Management, Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing, and Managed Security Services. Our expert team ensures that clients' businesses meet all regulatory requirements, identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities, and maintain robust, continuous protection against evolving cyber threats.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The HR \& Admin Intern will support the Human Resources team in talent acquisition, employee engagement, HR operations, recruitment coordination, and general office administration. This internship provides hands\-on exposure to end\-to\-end recruitment, onboarding, HR documentation, people operations, and day\-to\-day administrative support. The ideal candidate is enthusiastic about human resources, eager to learn, and excited to contribute to a fast\-growing cybersecurity organisation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes, schedule interviews, and coordinate with candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
* Support interview documentation, candidate tracking, and recruitment status updates.
* Assist in onboarding activities, including document collection, joining formalities, and new hire coordination.
* Maintain employee records, HR databases, recruitment trackers, and other HR documentation.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, internal events, and HR communication activities.
* Assist in preparing HR reports, recruitment metrics, and hiring dashboards.
* Coordinate with different departments to understand hiring requirements and support recruitment planning.
* Help maintain job descriptions, internship programs, and employer branding initiatives.
* Ensure confidentiality and accuracy while handling employee and candidate information.
* Provide general administrative support, including office coordination, vendor and courier follow\-ups, and upkeep of office supplies and facilities.
* Assist with general administrative tasks, filing, and record maintenance as required by the team.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Basic understanding of Human Resources and recruitment processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office, LinkedIn, and job portals is an added advantage.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work in a collaborative environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and time management skills.



  





**Education:** 
 Currently pursuing or recently completing a bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration or a related field or a master's in business administration (MBA) with a specialisation in Human Resources.
 



 Previous internships, academic projects, or coursework related to Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, or Recruitment will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Gain hands\-on experience in Talent Acquisition and Human Resource Operations.
* Work directly with leadership and hiring managers on real\-world recruitment initiatives.
* Develop practical skills in recruitment, onboarding, HR coordination, employee engagement, HR analytics, and office administration.
* Growth\-oriented culture built on Trust, Transparency, and Teamwork.
* Opportunity for a full\-time role based on performance and business requirements.



  





**To Apply** 




 Send your resume to hr@authenticone.com with the subject line:
 



**"HR \& Admin Intern – Bengaluru \| \[Your Name]"**

* Beschreibung


**Im Bereich "Accounting / Bookkeeping" bist du Teil der Finanzabteilung und baust ein Team für Buchhaltung, Abrechnung, Einkauf, Verkauf und Payment auf, welches der Geschäftsführung Report erstattet. Du bist verantwortlich für die finanziellen Dinge des Unternehmens und entwickelst proaktiv alle relevanten Prozesse und Abläufe.**
 Du koordinierst den Finanzbedarf für alle Teams, Projekte, Kampagnen oder Investments im Unternehmen und triffst Finanzentscheidungen mit deinem Finanz\-Team und/oder der Geschäftsleitung. Außerdem sorgst du für einen reibungsfreien Informationsfluss aller relevanten Finanzdaten / Metriken im Unternehmen sowie sauberes Reporting und Finanz\-Controlling.
   

  

* Deine Ziele


**Als Accounter / Bookkeeper erweiterst, trainierst und pflegst du stetig das Finanz\-Team. Du lenkst wichtige Aufgaben, schaffst Probleme im Finanz\-Bereich aus dem Weg und entwickelst eine Finanzplanung samt entsprechender Prozesse, KPIs und Controlling\-Instrumente, basierend auf den nächsten Meilensteinen des Unternehmens.**
 Als eines der Kernziele entwickelst du Prozessbeschreibungen und Dokumentationen rund um Finanzen, Buchhaltung sowie Lohn/Gehalt und dokumentierst die wichtigsten Prozesse, Systeme, Abläufe und Dokumente. Du optimierst den Ablauf finanzieller Transaktionen, sei es für Einkauf, Verkauf, Cashflow, Angebote, Payments oder Investitionen.
   

  

**Du nimmst deine Aufgaben so wahr...**
**✓** 
 dass alle in deinem Bereich anfallenden Aufgaben sachlich richtig, zügig, termingerecht, kompetent und wirtschaftlich erledigt werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die Grundsätze einer ordnungsgemäßen Buchführung jederzeit gewahrt bleiben und alle Daten in der Cloud verfügbar sind;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass alle Geschäftsvorgänge, die mit internen Werten zusammenhängen, planmäßig, lückenlos, und in zeitlichem Ablauf aufgezeichnet werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass sämtliche finanziellen Geschäftsvorfälle sich in ihrer Entstehung und Abwicklung verfolgen lassen und ausgewertet werden können;
   

  

**✓**

**✓**

**✓** 
 dass Daten während der Dauer der gesetzlichen Aufbewahrungsfristen verfügbar sind und jederzeit mit vertretbarem Aufwand lesbar gemacht werden können, insbesondere über Dashboards und Reporte;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass der Jahresabschluss den gesetzlichen Bestimmungen entsprechend vorbereitet und Vorgesetzten unterschriftsreif vorgelegt wird;
   

  

**✓**

**✓**

**✓** 
 dass die vorgesetzte Stelle jederzeit über den Stand der Entwicklung sowie über außergewöhnliche Vorkommnisse unterrichtet ist.
   

  

* Deine Aufgaben


**Deine Aufgaben Als Accounter / Bookkeeper Sind Vielfältig Und Müssen Sich Nicht Nur Auf Deine Position Beziehen. Vielmehr Sind Die Folgenden Aufgaben Im Kontext Deiner Position Sowie Ggf. Deines Teams Zu Verstehen, Mit Welchem Du Gemeinsam Arbeitest:**
**✓** 
 Entscheiden über Zeitpunkt und Form der Ausstellung von Rechnungen und Zahlungserinnerungen oder ggf. Mahnungen an Kunden;
   

  

**✓** 
 Beraten von Vorgesetzten bei der Festlegung und/oder Veränderung des Kontenrahmens sowie generell dem Ablauf von Buchungen;
   

  

**✓** 
 Umschichtungen zwischen verschiedenen Bankkonten oder Accounts, um das Unternehmen jederzeit Zahlungs\- und Investitionsfähig zu halten;
   

  

**✓** 
 Anschaffung von Hard\- / Software für den eigenen sowie für alle anderen Bereiche bzw. Abteilungen im Unternehmen, basierend auf Bedarf;
   

  

**✓** 
 Informieren der Vorgesetzten von Höhe und Zusammensetzung offener Posten, Zahlungserinnerungen oder unklarer Kontobewegungen;
   

  

**✓** 
 Aufbau von KPIs und Finanz\-Dashboards über automatisierte Excel\-Dashboards oder Cloud\-Dienste wie Klipfolio und Zapier;
   

  

**✓** 
 Entwicklung von geeigneten Controlling\-Instrumenten, um jederzeit Metriken über den finanziellen Zustand der Firma zu haben;

 Übersicht: Job für Business Process Engineer
   

  

* Titel: Business Process Engineer
* Firma: TrafficPrisma
* Website: www.trafficprisma.de
* Industrie: Consulting, Media, Marketing
* Verhältnis: Vollzeit, Freelance
* Arbeitszeiten: frei (zwischen 5\-20 Uhr), abgesehen von Meetings
* Ort: 100% Remote, Homeoffice bzw. Workation
* Sprache: Deutsch und Englisch
* Gehalt: Zwischen 36\.000 \- 72\.000 EUR / Jahr
* Verantwortung: Analyse, Design, Implementierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen; Unterstützung bei der Automatisierung von Prozessen; Optimierung von Prozessmanagement\-Systemen
* Fähigkeiten: Kenntnisse im Bereich Geschäftsprozessmanagement; Erfahrung in der Analyse und Optimierung von Prozessen; Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Prozessmanagement\-Tools und Methoden
* Qualifikationen: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar; Zertifizierung im Bereich Geschäftsprozessmanagement von Vorteil; Erfahrung in der Anwendung von C.O.R.E., BPMN, Six Sigma oder Lean Business
* Beschreibung


**Als "Business Process Engineer" planst, entwickelst und optimierst du alle Prozesse, Systeme, Abläufe, Workflows und Dokumentationen von TrafficPrisma, sowie insbesondere des C.O.R.E. Frameworks. Du führst Prozess\-Interviews mit Kollegen sowie Experten durch und machst das Unternehmen samt TrafficPrisma\-Account DIN/ISO\-fähig.**
 Du modellierst alle relevanten Prozesse bei TrafficPrisma, entwickelst die dazugehörigen Dokumentationen und Hilfsmittel (Vorlagen, Templates, Mockups, Arbeitsanweisungen, Checklisten etc.) und sorgst für maximale Prozessautomation. Außerdem bist du verantwortlich für die Auswahl der richtigen KPIs pro Prozess sowie das Monitoring aller KPIs.
   

  

* Deine Ziele


**Dein primäres Ziel als Business\-Process\-Engineer ist es, alle internen Prozesse und Dokumentationen aufzubauen sowie in das C.O.R.E. Framework zu integrieren, sodass TrafficPrisma, die Kunden\-Accounts sowie das Framework selbst DIN/ISO\-fähig wird. Damit einher geht die Lizenzierung eines genormten Firmen\-Prototypen.**
 Als weiteres Kernziel planst und definierst du alle wichtigen KPIs unserer Prozesse, entwickelst dafür Mess\-, Tracking\- und Monitoring\-Methoden bzw. setzt diese auf und führst regelmäßig Prozessinterviews mit internen und externen Experten, um deren Know\-How in professionelle Prozesse, Abläufe und Workflows zu übersetzen und zu dokumentieren.
   

  

**Du nimmst deine Aufgaben so wahr...**
**✓** 
 dass alle in deinem Bereich anfallenden Aufgaben sachlich richtig, zügig, termingerecht, kompetent und wirtschaftlich erledigt werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass unsere Dokumentationen den Bestimmungen der Produkthaftung, den relevanten DIN, ISO und EN\-Normen, internen Richtlinien sowie relevanten Normen und Gesetzen entsprechen;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die Vorgaben der internen Auftraggeber in klar verständlichen Diagrammen, Sprache und BPMN\-Notation verfasst werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass in den fertigen Dokumentationen die Informationen einfach zu finden, zu verstehen sowie schnell umzusetzen sind;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die Dokumentationen dem allgemeinen Gebrauch sowie Stand der Technik entsprechen, sprich internen Apps und dem Techstack;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass alle Prozesse klare KPIs vorweisen und diese sauber gemessen sowie in digitalen Cloud\-Dashboards zusammengefasst werden können;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die aktuellen Kostenbudgets sowie die festgelegten sachlichen, systemischen und terminlichen Vorgaben eingehalten werden;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass Vorgesetzte über den Stand der Entwicklung bei Dokumentationen sowie über außergewöhnliche Vorkommnisse unterrichtet sind;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass Betriebsgeheimnisse und die Vertraulichkeit von internen Prozessen, Abläufen und Dokumentationen jederzeit gewahrt bleiben;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass die technische Dokumentation so erstellt wird, dass Auftraggeber sowie spätere Nutzer des C.O.R.E. Frameworks schnell und vollständig ihre Unternehmen aufbauen, organisieren und steuern können;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass das Layout aller Dokumentationen auf Klarheit, Simplizität und Sauberkeit getrimmt wird, um die Struktur besser zu verdeutlichen;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass alle Prozesse so gestaltet werden, dass Übersetzungen in andere Sprachen jederzeit kostengünstig angefertigt werden können;
   

  

**✓** 
 dass der Informationsfluss mit anderen Abteilungen stets reibungslos funktioniert und eine gute Zusammenarbeit gewährleistet ist.
   

  

* Deine Aufgaben


**Deine Aufgaben Als Business\-Process\-Engineer Sind Vielfältig, Müssen Sich Jedoch Nicht Direkt Nur Auf Deine Position Beziehen. Vielmehr Sie Im Kontext Deiner Position Und Deines Teams Zu Verstehen, Welches Du Führst Oder Mit Welchem Du Gemeinsam Arbeitest:**
**✓** 
 Ausarbeitung von Richtlinien, Checklisten, Hilfsmaterialien, Prozessen und schriftlichen Anweisungen für den Bereich Geschäftsprozesse;
   

  

**✓** 
 Entwicklung relevanter Prozesse, Systeme, Abläufe, Workflows, Vorlagen, Dokumente und Dokumentationen für das C.O.R.E. Framework;
   

  

**✓** 
 Beratung Vorgesetzter bei Kalkulation und Budgetierung interner Projekte sowie Hinzuziehung externer Spezialisten bei Entwicklungsaufträgen;
   

  

**✓** 
 Informieren alle betroffenen Stellen über eventuelle Verzögerungen bei der Fertigstellung von Prozessen und Dokumentationen;

 Kontrolle der von externen Dienstleistern beigesteuerten Teile der Dokumentation auf Übereinstimmung mit unseren Standards;

**✓**

 emotional kontrolliert, wenn es hektisch und/oder stressig wird

 Du bist für Anschaffung, Pflege und den Transport des gesamten Video\-Equipments zuständig, planst selbstständig Video\-Locations, organisierst ggf. notwendiges Video\-Footage\-Material sowie Sounds zur Vertonung und übernimmst alle Schritte der Video\-Produktion, vom Scripting, über die Aufnahmen, visuelles Storytelling, Vertonung und Abmischung.

**Dein oberstes Ziel als Video\-Content\-Creator ist es, das gesamte Leben und Arbeiten aller Teams und Mitarbeiter bei TrafficPrisma auf eine emotionale, spannende, kurzweilige und sympathische Weise in Videos zu visualisieren. Kurz gesagt, du erhältst die Aufgabe übertragen, einen Superbrand zu formen und in Youtube aufzubauen.**
 Als ein weiteres Kernziel produzierst und emotionalisierst du alle Arten von Videos, Filmen und Trailern, die mit Vertrieb, Verkauf, Marketing, Branding oder Listbuilding zu tun haben.
